[quote]Our priority is to prevent and fix errors related to the Black Market and newly applied features, and to ensure their stability.

notes.title: [GM Note] Together, We Go Further! PD Leadership Update!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is GM Cuckoo.

Today, I would like to share an important announcement with all Agents.

In order to provide long-term service for Closers and to strengthen our communication with all Agents, we are pleased to inform you of an update to our PD leadership.

PD Hyun-Jun Kang who is currently managing Closers will oversee the overall management. In addition, a new PD has joined the Closers project to further support and enhance the game's direction.

With both PDs now working together, Closers will continue to develop in a more positive direction, with increased communication and engagement with all Agents.

Accordingly, we have conducted an interview with each PD to address the questions you may have.

We are pleased to now share their responses with you.
Shall we begin?


[h3][color=#89CFF0][b]▶ Interview with PD Hyun-Jun Kang[/b][/color][/h3]

[b]Q. Over the past two years, you’ve overseen many updates as the dedicated PD of Closers. To what extent do you feel your initial goals have been achieved?[/b]

A. When I first assumed the role of PD for Closers, my top priority was “optimization.”
As the game had been live for many years, various efforts had been made to enhance the environment—such as transitioning to 64-bit, supporting 120 FPS, and upgrading to DirectX 11. However, these improvements had sometimes led to unintended issues, including frame drops and performance degradation.

With that in mind, I firmly believed that establishing a stable and seamless environment should come first.
I would say that approximately 85% of the goals I set have been achieved over the past two years.

Another objective was to revitalize the narrative flow among the teams.
To that end, we actively developed new characters and made considerable efforts to integrate them naturally into the existing teams—for example, characters such as Ria Yoon and Triss. I'm grateful that many Agents responded positively to these additions.


[b]Q. There have been various updates, including Break Challenge, new characters, raids, and QoL improvements. What were the guiding principles behind these decisions?[/b]

A. Rather than following a rigid structure, I focused on identifying what was most needed at each point in time.
During summer and winter, we prioritized large-scale content, while spring and fall were typically dedicated to system improvements and quality-of-life updates.

At each stage, we carefully examined what the Agents most needed and what areas required enhancement, allowing us to determine the proper priorities. Thanks to this approach, each seasonal update took on its own unique characteristics.


[b]Q. Among the updates that have been released thus far, is there anything you found regrettable?[/b]

A. In our efforts to enhance the enjoyment of farming, we implemented various initiatives—one of which was Break Challenge: Fly King.

At the time, we wanted to introduce an element of randomness to break away from the monotony of existing farming structures. Additionally, we sought to reinterpret existing raid bosses in new ways to offer a fresh combat experience.

However, in hindsight, we recognize that this approach may not have aligned with the expectations of our Agents. The random nature without guaranteed drops, and the lack of intuitive combat patterns, ultimately caused inconvenience. I feel bad that we were not able to fully deliver the enjoyment we had intended.


[b]Q. On a different note—could you tell us a bit about the newly joining PD?[/b]

A. The new PD has a wealth of experience operating a wide range of games, having worked with our company for many years. Most importantly, he has a genuine affection and passion for Closers.

With his diverse background, he brings a fresh perspective and new approaches. I firmly believe he will offer new enjoyment and improved experiences for our Agents. As I continue to oversee overall management, I will work closely with him and share insights to ensure consistent quality going forward.

I kindly ask for your warm support and encouragement for our newly joined PD.

 
[h3][color=#89CFF0][b]▶ Interview with PD Lee Hyun Soo[/b][/color][/h3]

[b]Q. You seem like a familiar face. Could you please introduce yourself briefly?[/b]

A. Greetings. My name is Lee Hyunsoo, and I have recently joined Closers as its sixth PD.
It has now been over seven years since I joined NADDIC Games. Although I officially became part of the Closers team around May of this year, I had already been observing the project and the work of previous PDs closely in the company.

While I am no longer active in broadcasting area, there may be some who recognize me from occasional appearances on game-related broadcasts. If, by unfortunate algorithmic recommendation, my face happened to reach your screen, I extend my apologies for any visual inconvenience caused.


[b]Q. How do you feel about stepping into the role of PD following PD Hyun Jun Kang?[/b]

A. I feel a great sense of responsibility.

“Sixth.”

The fact that the number has increased by one may seem trivial, but it carries significant weight. Of course, the number itself is not as important as the role it signifies. I hope to serve as a “Bridge”, maintaining the positive legacy built by the previous PDs while also steadily addressing areas for improvement. Rather than declaring a complete overhaul, I intend to take a thoughtful approach—focusing on consistent improvement and advancement based on the foundation that has already been established.


[b]Q. Have you been playing Closers since the beginning?[/b]

A. Closers is a title I have followed since its early development phase. Although circumstances led to it being serviced by another publisher at the time, I continued to observe its progress with interest. After joining NADDIC Games, I became even more closely involved with the project. There was a brief period when I had to step away due to other responsibilities, but I have since returned and am now fully dedicated to the project.


[b]Q. Which characters are you currently playing?[/b]

A. While I do play all characters, I currently focus primarily on five:
Yuri, Triss, Mistel, Lucy, and Ria.


[b]Q. Many Agents may feel uncertain due to the leadership change. Will this shift in PD result in any significant changes to update schedules or overall direction?[/b]
A. While the change may appear sudden from the perspective of our Agents, I have in fact been working alongside PD Kang prior to formally taking on the role, sharing in decision-making as part of the transition process. Both PD Kang and I have placed strong emphasis on striking a balance between continuity and change. 

Major scheduled updates will proceed as planned, without significant alterations. In between, we intend to introduce improvements to outdated systems where necessary. 

In particular, we are committed to responding promptly to ongoing concerns raised by our Agents—such as service stability and suggestions regarding update content. While we recognize that there may still be room for improvement, we are actively gathering feedback across various channels and will do our best to address it accordingly. We ask for your continued patience and support as we move forward.


[b]Q. Were there any aspects of Closers you personally hoped to improve upon once you became PD?[/b]

A. One of my medium- to long-term goals is to move beyond repetitive gameplay loops, such as “Xue/Triss/Gildal” or “Dogra/Magra/Integrated Farming Dungeon,” and instead create spaces and moments where Agents can truly enjoy staying within the game. In addition, as the service lifespan of Closers grows longer, we have seen a gradual decline in accessibility for new and returning Agents. I aim to explore ways to open up these entry points once again. Of course, no single solution can address everything. Therefore, I hope to experiment with various approaches and remain open to strong feedback if our direction ever diverges from expectations. Our Agents’ voices will serve as the foundation for growth and positive change.


[b]Q. There are a few updates that were previously announced but have yet to be implemented—for example, the Crew Leader Delegation system and bundled costume sales. What is the current status of these items?[/b]

A. These features have not been abandoned. They remain on our list of pending development tasks. We fully understand that many Agents are awaiting these updates and have expressed their opinions regarding them. Although their implementation has been delayed due to a focus on service stability, we will make every effort to resume development and apply them as soon as possible. 
Given that Closers is a title that has been developed over many years and by many hands, certain changes—even minor ones—can produce unexpected ripple effects. Some delays arise from the need to introduce new systems while also ensuring overall stability. That said, we recognize the importance of keeping our Agents informed and offering transparency about the status of such developments. We will work to not only deliver quality content, but also to communicate more frequently with you—sharing our thoughts and development progress more openly and regularly.


[b]Q. Do you have any unique strategies or approaches to further revitalize Closers?[/b]

A. First and foremost, we are preparing a space and time in which we can actively listen to the voices of our Agents. While we are still finalizing the schedule and format, we plan to hold a session where feedback can be heard in real time—or as close to it as possible. We will provide detailed information regarding the schedule and method in the near future.


[b]Q. Could you share your vision or any final message for the Agents of Closers?[/b]

A. This coming winter, Closers will celebrate its 11th anniversary, launching in Korea. While it may sound cliché, our development team—including PD Hyun Jun Kang as the overall manager—will continue to unite our efforts in order to ensure that Closers remains a game you can enjoy with satisfaction not only now, but all the way to its 20th anniversary and beyond.

Thank you for your continued support.

Today, we have shared interviews with PD Lee Hyun Soo, who has newly joined Closers, and PD Hyun-Jun Kang, who will continue to oversee overall management.

Lastly, both PDs have each written a special message for all Closers Agents.
 
Please click the link below to read their letters:

notes.title: July 9th Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]Characters[/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. 1st Skill System Revamp[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Skill system has been revamped.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Skill Point Revamp[/b][/color]
[list][*] Character lv. specific Skill Points are applied to all characters regardless of the character’s current SP.
[*] All characters now receive 3 Skill Points for each level increase.
[*] All characters receive 5 Skill Points for each 10 level increase. (i.e. At lv.10, lv.20... lv.90)
[*] Skill Points granted every 10 levels will not be distributed together with Skill Upgrade Points.
※ It will be 303 Skill Points when the character reaches lv.95.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Active Skill Revamp[/b][/color]
[list][*] Active Skills no longer consume Skill Points directly.
[*] Skills are now learned automatically based on Promotion requirement and level.
[*] [Support] skill items are no longer consumed. Skills will be automatically learned once the requirements are met.
[*] All eligible skills will auto-level when the character levels up.
[*] Skills eligible for EX conversion will be automatically converted.
[*] The passive learning requirement has been removed from the 5th Skill's learning requirement.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Passive Skill Revamp[/b][/color]
[list][*] Polish Passive Skills remain unchanged and are still optional to use.
[*] Passive Skills remain unchanged and levels can still be adjusted.
[*] Character specific Passive Skills no longer consume Skill Points to level up.
[*] 5th Passive Skill level is no longer adjustable, stat increase is now fixed at the current max level.
※ All Passive Skill Points will be reset after the update. Please redistribute them accordingly.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Skill Ticket Item Adjustment[/b][/color]
[list]
[*] Skill Tickets are no longer usable following the skill system revamp. 'Unusable' has been added to the item description.
[*] Skill tickets have been discontinued from the UNION Store.
[*] The following methods are no longer available to acquire Skill Tickets:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bc0589ee90de3259e8f5ab077aa111dca9db88da.png[/img][/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ UI Adjustment[/b][/color]
[list][*] [Skill Reset] check box in the Active Skill tab: the [EX] and [Master] buttons are no longer displayed.
[*] In Skill Tip descriptions, the requirements for already fulfilled conditions are no longer displayed.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Additional Notes on the UI Adjustment[/b][/color]
[list][*] Active skills are now automatically sorted by learning order in the character’s skill window.
[*] A notification will be displayed when a new skill is learned through upgrading.
[*] A notification will be displayed when a learned skill is upgraded.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]New Contents[/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Integrated Farming Dungeon[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Introduced the ‘Integrated Farming Dungeon’.

notes.title: [Important Notice] Update on N-coin Removal Policy for Inactive Accounts
notes.notes:
Hello Agents,

We would like to clarify our recent announcement regarding the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/215830/view/542234849189036423]removal of unused N-coins from inactive accounts[/url].

After careful reconsideration and listening to your feedback, we have decided [b]not to proceed with removing N-coins[/b] from inactive accounts.

We sincerely apologize for the confusion and concern caused by our previous notice. That decision was misguided, and we understand it did not reflect your perspectives or the trust you've placed in us.

We acknowledge our mistake and take full responsibility for it. Please rest assured: [b]your N-coins are safe and will not be deleted[/b].

We remain committed to building practices that center around your experience and trust. Thank you for your understanding.

As an expression of our sincere apology, a small apology box will be given to all Agents during the next maintenance. This is a gesture of our gratitude for your patience and continued support.

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please send an email to: [url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url] or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/523831205fe9db127e6cd888bbcdaf695468ab22.png[/img][/url]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,    

The first phase of the Skill System Renewal is scheduled to be implemented on [b]July 9, 2025[/b].

In line with this update, the sale and acquisition of Skill Tickets will be fully discontinued. Additionally, any Skill Tickets currently in your possession will be changed to unusable items.

[i][b]Therefore, if you currently have any skill ticket items, please use them all up before the update on July 9, 2025 to avoid any inconvenience.[/b][/i]

Please refer to the detailed information below:

[color=#89CFF0][b]■ [Pre-Notice] Changes to Skill Tickets Due to Skill System Renewal[/b][/color]

[b]Schedule:[/b] After maintenance on July 9, 2025

[b]Details:[/b][list][*]Due to the skill system renewal, Skill Ticket items will become unusable.
※ After the update, Support Skills previously obtained via Skill Tickets will be automatically granted based on character level.[/*][*]Skill Ticket products will be removed from the shop.[/*][/list][*]The following sources will no longer provide Skill Tickets:[/*]

[table][tr][td]

One-shot Growth Lv.95

[/td][td]

NPC shop

[/td][/tr][/table]

[list][*] Skill Tickets in your inventory or storage will not be deleted.
[*] These items will be updated according to the new system.
[*] Further details on the renewal will be announced in upcoming notices.
[*] The schedule for the system update may change, so please stay tuned for future announcements.[/list]
Please refer to the information provided above to avoid any inconvenience while playing Closers. We will do our best to introduce more interesting content and events for all of you.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you that a client patch has been deployed to fix an issue where the in-game N-coin Charge button was redirecting users to another Closers server. We sincerely apologize for any frustration or confusion this may have caused. The issue should be fully resolved with this client patch, and the button will now direct you correctly to the World server.

Please re-login to the game and update your launcher to apply the changes.

If you encounter any other bugs or issues, please send us an email to: support@closersonline.com or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

[*] After: N mark removed when receiving all items in Purchase History[/list][*] When purchasing the last item registered in [Black Market] or [Purchase Reservation Black Market], a system message is displayed instead of a pop-up window.

notes.title: September 11th Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/reign-of-the-dragon-king-new-dungeon-gears-events-DIbDHe1106][b]1. New Dungeon <Reign of the Dragon King>[/b][/url][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Dungeon ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon is available by completing each corresponding quest, after accepting [False Preparation] Quest at Fantasy World : Dream Theater <<Reverse>> Town.
[list][*] Cradle of Dragons (1 player), Paris under Dragon’s domination (1 player): [The Power of the Dragon] Quest
[*] Cradle of Dragons (4 players), Paris under Dragon’s domination (4 players): [The Two Dragons] Quest[/list][*] ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon is available by <Commander Subjugation Supporter - LeBlanc> NPC at Fantasy World : Dream Theater <<Reverse>>, The end: The world in flames, and Noah's Museum town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bd049d41455c38a7748410224ae404f374b9275a.png[/img]

[*] You can enter ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ dungeon, which has a fixed entry limit of 1 player, using the entrance ticket that can be obtained from 4 players dungeon.
[list][*] Entrance Material Item: Dragon Queen Astarte (1 player) Entrance Ticket, Dragon King Hecatoncheir (1 player) Entrance Ticket
[/list][*] You can acquire the additional reward through Bonus Reward System, at ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ 4 players Dungeon. (Once per character per week)
[*] You can acquire New Chip, Boss Accessory and Armband depending on the rate by clearing ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon.
[*] You can acquire Material Item and ‘Dragon King's Noble Random Chest’ Item which are required for New Gear Craft and Upgrade, by clearing ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ dungeon.[list]
[*] New Gear: Furious Dragon Queen Staff/Whip, Furious Ancient Dragon Bright Core/Chakram, Astarte Disc
[*] Material Item: Shining Dragon Core Piece, Noble Dragon Core[list][color=#5f95cc]※ ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ can be acquired by Bonus Reward of 4 players' dungeon, and ‘Dragon King's Noble Random Chest’ can be acquired by Bonus Reward of 4 players' dungeon or Drop Reward of 1 player dungeon. 
※ ‘Noble Dragon Core’ can be acquired when opening Dragon King's Noble Random Chest, and Tradable Extra Core can be acquired with low probability.[/color][/list][/list][*] ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon-related New UNION Watch, Growth Guide Mission, Farming Guide, and Achievement have been added. [/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Dragon King Boss Accessory & Illust Armband have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Dragon King Boss Accessory 6 kinds and Boss Illust Armband 2 kinds have been added.
[list][*] Dragon King Boss Accessory and Illust Armband can be acquired depending on each rate by clearing ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ 1 player/ 4 players dungeon.  
[*] Dragon King Boss Accessory and Illust Armband can be crafted through Craft NPC, by consuming ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ and Credit.[/list][list][list]However, accessories and illustration armbands are obtained as non-repackaging specifications in case of craft.[/list][/list][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Bonus Reward System[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Bonus Reward System has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Bonus Reward System is a system that allows you to obtain additional rewards equal to the number of times you can receive rewards without having to click a separate button after clearing a dungeon.
[*] Dungeons with the Bonus Reward System set will display the icon and the number of times you can receive rewards on the lower left of the dungeon image in the entrance UI.
[list][*] Target Dungeon: Cradle of Dragons (4 players), Paris under Dragon’s domination (4 players), Castle of Darkness[/list][*] When you hover over the Bonus Reward icon and the number of times you can receive the reward in the dungeon entry UI, a description of the Bonus Reward will be displayed.
[*] Items and specifications obtained as Bonus Reward will be displayed in the Bonus Reward UI after clearing the dungeon.
[*] If you have used up all the number of times you can receive the Bonus Reward, the Bonus Reward UI will not be displayed even if you clear the dungeon.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. New Epic Core[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Epic Core ‘Furious Dragon Queen Staff/Whip’ and 'Furious Ancient Dragon Bright Core/Chakram’ have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] 4 kinds of New Epic Core have been added, and all can be equipped regardless of character's battle type. 
[*] New Epic Core's Enhancement Transfer Group has been added. 
[*] New Epic Core can be crafted and upgraded by consuming main materials, ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ and Credit through Craft NPC. 
[*] New Epic Core's Required Level is 94 and can be upgraded by Atropos grade.
[*] New Epic Core will have the Unleash Option activated and applied when it reaches Enhancement Lv. 18, 22, 26, and 30.
[list][*] New Epic Core 4 kinds Option[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/71bb190274e1b06783a9466c191988376786654d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e011caeae43cf69541015a07dc2037a60352742d.png[/img]
[*] New Epic Core Triggering Effect
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/7240fee06632e8119d287b6b7e574ee8fc11875b.png[/img]

[*] New Epic Core Unleash Option
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/22936a6c6f8e56ec48671bd81daa6baf11760bdf.png[/img][/list]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. New Extra Core[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Extra Core ‘Fallen Dragon Queen Staff/Whip’, ‘Fallen Ancient Dragon Bright Core/Chakram’ have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] 4 kinds of New Extra Core have been added and all are equippable regardless of character's battle type.
[*] New Extra Core's Enhancement Transfer Group has been added.
[*] New Extra Core can be obtained from ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon, and details are as follows.
[list][*] Acquire by opening ‘Dragon King's Noble Random Chest’ depending on each probability that can be obtained from Reign of the Dragon King (4 players) Dungeon Bonus Reward and Reign of the Dragon King (1 player) Dungeon Drop Reward.
[*] Upgrade Dragon King Epic Core of Atropos grade into Extra Core, by consuming ‘Noble Dragon Core’ that can be acquired from Dragon King's Noble Random Chest, and Credit.[list][*] (Extra Core obtained through the upgrade cannot be traded on Black Market or cannot move to Account Storage.)[/list][/list][*] New Extra Core displays effects around the character or monster depending on the triggering effect, when applying it.
[*] New Extra Core will have the Unleash Option activated and applied when it reaches Enhancement lv. 18, 22, 26, and 30.
[list][*] New Extra Core 4 kinds Option[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e331f05a847e1fc517092aab46a74e783f0f5142.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e246b7d1d2b99a5ca16b87e21faa214174f128fa.png[/img]
[*] New Extra Core Triggering Effect
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/54383fc751f84fc599f9a48be1339b459d04bcd6.png[/img]

[*] New Extra Core Unleash Option
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/53066212abf119efd474a029f618af542e4c0863.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. New Phase Awakening & New Chip[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Phase Awakening Gear ‘Astarte Disc’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list]
[*] ‘Astarte Disc I’ can be obtained by upgrading ‘Dragon Disc III’ item by consuming main materials ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ and Credit. 
[*] ‘Astarte Disc I’ can be upgraded by ‘Astarte Disc III’ through  Upgrade NPC.
[*] ‘Astarte Disc’ can't be traded on Black Market Trade and can't be moved to Account Storage.
[*] When opening Chip Slot, you can equip a new chip that can be acquired from ‘Dragon's Vanguard’ or ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon.
[*] You can use the active option by equipping ‘Astarte Disc’ at Skill Slot.
[list][*] New Phase Awakening <Astarte Disc> Option[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/35e5ffbe11d71c5b20ddadb549f9ef99cb8abb29.png[/img][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Chip ‘Dragon Queen Astarte Chip’ and ‘Dragon King Hecatoncheir Chip’ have been added.[/b][/color]
[list]
[*] You can acquire ‘Dragon Queen Astarte Chip’ depending on each rate, by clearing ‘Cradle of Dragons’ dungeon.
[*] You can acquire ‘Dragon King Hecatoncheir Chip’ depending on each rate, by clearing ‘Paris under Dragon’s domination’ dungeon.
[*] 2 kinds of new chips can be equipped to ‘Dragon Disc’ and ‘Astarte Disc’.
[*] Craft, Overclock, Inherit, and Transfer are not available for 2kinds of new chips.
[list][*] New Chip 2kinds Option[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/dadd94aa1f92113ed74768ba5f13b162c7bf5318.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6. Dungeon Skill Additional[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Dungeon skills and dungeons where dungeon skills can be used have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] New Dungeon Skill can be used by acquiring it after playing the target dungeon.
[list][*] Target Dungeon: Paris under Dragon’s domination (1 player, 4 players)[/list][*] For dungeons where you can use dungeon skills, you can check them in the dungeon entry information window and in the upper right area when entering the dungeon.
[*] Dungeon Skill can only be used by the Squad Leader.
[*] New Dungeon Skill Gauge can be acquired when the dungeon gimmick is successful.
[list][*] New Dungeon Skill Type and Consuming Gauge[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/2048a9c0f96fe641f951f0618dcc07fec51d3331.png[/img][/list][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]7. Enhancement System Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Enhancement System has been improved.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Physical/Psi Attack Power, Physical/Psi Crit Damage amount that would be increased when trinket item enhancement success has been increased.
[*] The Enhancement Rate Increase used to be applied through Enhancement Buff Voucher Item has been applied to the Basic Enhancement Rate. [[url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/enhancement-rate-notice-DD1ioZ1117][b]Go to Enhancement Rate Notice[/b][/url]]
[*] Enhancement fail rate targeting Enhancement +16, +17 grade has been removed.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Guaranteed Enhancement System has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Guaranteed Enhancement System is a system where the Guaranteed Enhancement Points are accumulated in an item according to the enhancement result value, and the enhancement is guaranteed to succeed when trying enhancement after reaching the maximum point value.
[*] If the Guaranteed Enhancement Point is accumulative over the maximum, the next enhancement try will succeed at a 100% rate, and the accumulative Guaranteed Enhancement Points will be reset.
[*] Guaranteed Enhancement Points are displayed in the lower right corner of the Enhancement System UI and in the Gear Item Tooltip.
[*] Guaranteed Enhancement Points accumulate when enhancement failure is prevented by adding Gear Booster Fortifier or when there is no change in enhancement.
[*] Guaranteed Enhancement Point is reset when enhancement success/great success or using Gear Booster or Enhancement Transfer Device.
[*] Guaranteed Enhancement Point is maintained when Enhancement Fail, Black Market Item Trade, Item Upgrade.  
[list]However, if Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceed the maximum in the lower Enhancement stage when Enhancement fails, the Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceeding the maximum will be removed.
(ex: If you acquired 15,000 Guaranteed Enhancement Points with +18 stage Gear and Enhancement fails, the Enhancement stage will be lowered to +17 stage, and the 3,000 points exceeding +17 stage (Maximum value 12,000) will be removed.[/list][*] Guaranteed Enhancement Point is acquired differently depending on the material item used for Enhancement.
[list][*] Acquire Guaranteed Enhancement Point 100pt when using ‘Gear Booster Fuel I’
[*] Acquire Guaranteed Enhancement Point 130pt when using ‘Lucky Gear Boost I’[/list][*] The maximum value of the Guaranteed Enhancement Point is different depending on the enhancement level.
[*] If you have acquired the Guaranteed Enhancement Point Maximum of the current Enhancement stage during continuous Enhancement, continuous Enhancement will end and the Guaranteed Enhancement Pop-up window will be displayed.
[*] When you try Enhancement in a status that has reached the Guaranteed Enhancement Point Maximum, Enhancement Material/Enhancement Additives/Credit will not be consumed.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ All Gear Items' enhancement stage has been expanded to a maximum of 30.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Gear effects for the expanded enhancement stages have been added.
[*] Chip Overclock's maximum level expansion will be applied through future updates.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]8. Unleash Option[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Unleash Option has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] A new system, ‘Unleash Option’, has been added to some Gear Items.
[list][*] Target Gear: Dragon King Epic Atropos Core, Dragon King Extra Core, Furious Dragon Module[/list][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Unleash Option has been added to Furious Dragon Module.[/b][/color]
[list]
[*] The Unleash Option has been added to Atropos grade's Furious Dragon Module.
[*] ‘Unleash Option’ is activated sequentially when the target gear reaches the enhancement stage guided in Item Tooltip.
[list][*] Furious Dragon Module Unleash Option[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b7fead1389a513a28eb8fb8f2a9bdb46d0c7fb6b.png[/img]
[*] ‘Unleash Option’ is displayed below Tuning Option and above Chip Option in Item Tooltip.
[*] Activated Unleash Option is displayed in ‘light blue’ in Item Tooltip, and Deactivated Unleash Option is displayed in ‘gray’.
[*] The effect of Deactivated Unleash Option is not applied.
[*] Unleash Option related game guide has been added.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]9. Yoon Ria Skill Balance Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria Characters' some skill balance has been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Target Skill's some tooltip descriptions have been added and modified.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/df93435b550c8b8017f6bb14c89d4053b86d6ecf.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Skill damage has been added and some skill damage's coefficient has been adjusted.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/1d848779a1b2677cd583beda59ec0cc853b003a9.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Growth Guide System[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Growth Guide System has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] <Growth Guide> is a system that guides you through various content by clearing each stage's mission consisting of main content.
[*] When you click the Growth Guide button on the upper right, a dedicated UI will appear.
[*] When you click the 'Guide' button for each mission, a guide UI window related to the corresponding mission will open.
[*] When you click the 'Move Now' button for each mission, a UI window required for clearing the mission will open or you will move to the location of the related NPC.
[list]
[*] If the town you would move to is not open yet, the 'Move Now' button will be disabled.
[color=#c3a3ff]※ Some missions cannot be performed with the character Yoon Ria, and you will be able to move and clear it after the upcoming promotion update.[/color][/list][*] All mission clear rewards can be obtained once per account.
[*] Even if you have obtained the reward, you can click the 'Guide' button and 'Move Now' button for the mission.  
[*] The displayed TCP is the recommended TCP for performing mission, and you can check and clear the next stage's mission not clearing the previous mission.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Washing Machine Accumulative Purchase Reset[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The function to reset accumulated purchases for Washing Machine has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] [Accum. Purchase Reset] button will be created after acquiring all the accumulative purchase rewards from the Washing Machine.
[*] When the [Accum. Purchase Reset] button is clicked, the ‘Accumulated purchase reward record’ for the corresponding washing machine will be reset, and rewards can be obtained from the beginning again depending on the accumulated purchase quantity.
[*] [Accum. Purchase Reset] button will disappear when the accumulated purchase reward record is reset by clicking [Accum. Purchase Reset] button.
[*] If clicking [Accum. Purchase Reset] button, [Current Accumulative Purchase] amount will be deducted by the maximum accumulated purchase reward requirement.[list][*] e.g.: When the maximum accumulated purchase reward requirement for washing machine is 800 and the [Reset accumulated purchases] button is clicked after purchasing it 850 times, the current accumulated purchase quantity will be changed to 50.[/list][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Script Window Hide Function[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The function to hide the script window for enjoying quest illust has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] When you press [V] while the Quest script window is open, the script window will be hidden.
[*] After the Quest script window is hidden, pressing [V], [X], [Z], or [ESC] will reappear the hidden script window.[/list]

notes.title: [Developer Letter] Summer 2024 Update Plan
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Agents!

I am the PD of Closers, Hyun-Jun Kang.

Greetings once again through this August Developer's Letter.

In this Developer's Letter, we aim to address any curiosities that our Agents may have by providing additional information about the upcoming summer updates.


[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][August 7th][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<New Character Yoon Ria Launch>[/b][/h3]
The 21st new character, Yoon Ria, joins Closers after about a year and a half.

The new character, Ria, initially awakened her phase force early on, underwent some trials, gave up being a Phase user, debuted as an idol, and then returned as a Closer.

The story of how Ria returned to being a Closer from being an idol will unfold through the update on August 7.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/285177ab838878874952086276bff3730efc072c.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yoon Ria Novice Agent Illustration[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
We have put our best effort into capturing Ria's narrative and personality through details such as taking selfies and gestures where she holds a microphone to sing.

We have meticulously created each motion and effect from scratch to present an attractive character, and we look forward to seeing many players enjoy Closers with the new character.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5ed9fda072495e0729d7e0632090e4baaafc0048.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yoon Ria Regular Agent Illustration[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
Especially since Ria is joining the Black Lamb team for the first time since Misteltein, we plan to introduce new chemistry with the existing Black Lamb members and showcase another charm of the Black Lamb team.

[h3][b]<Growth Guide>[/b][/h3]
A Growth Guide will be added to help the New/Returning Agents to get back into the game faster.

For Agents who are struggling to settle in due to the old systems and accumulated content, we have prepared a system in the growth guide. Upon first logging into the game, you can immediately check which dungeons you should go to at your current level, what actions to take next, and move directly to the relevant area with just a click.


[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][August 21st][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<Yoon Ria Special, Prime Agent & Other Stories>[/b][/h3]
The update for Yoon Ria's Special Agent and Prime Agent will include the continuation of the story from the International Airport.

You can also look forward to a specially produced ending video for Yoon Ria. We hope you look forward to it!

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/08bde016c7c2272852b334d5af779c2c8b69cc0a.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yoon Ria Special Agent Illustration[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
Regarding Yoon Ria's skills and promotion configuration, as you might expect, Ria does not have a Task Force promotion.

This means that her Special Agent promotion will include three normal skills and one Special Move, while her Prime Agent role will add two normal skills and one Special Move, similar to other characters.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a5ee4ce33951e70a3d7dedff0b0cb18cea9049a5.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yoon Ria Prime Agent Illustration[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
We aim to present Yoon Ria’s Special and Prime Agent updates with a high level of quality.

[h3][b]<Summer Dungeon: Dragon's Vanguard>[/b][/h3]
The highly anticipated 'Dragon's Vanguard' update, the prelude of Dragon King, is coming soon.

You will have the opportunity to face the 'Indomitable Gatekeeper,' Andras, and 'Violet Vanguard,' representing the younger years of Astaroth.

A new story and battles involving these characters await you.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/401814be406eb1d8deead4568ab752cec5d59ca2.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d89ac04ccd78703906a36d1d48eb4314dd03e674.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]Indomitable Gatekeeper[/b]
[/td][td]
[b]Violet Vanguard[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
In 'Dragon's Vanguard,' along with 'DRAGONISH Trans Discs,' announced in 'Closers Channel ON Ep.2', there has been a change to update two types of craftable modules. This update aims to enhance the gameplay of 'Dragon's Vanguard,' allowing players to access new gear more swiftly.

The 'DRAGONISH Trans Disc' will be updated from the existing Trans Discs : Supreme to include on-use effects.

These effects will be available for Trans Discs from levels 4 to 6, while previous levels will receive a set minor increase in stats. Please look forward to collecting these from levels 1 to 3 in 'Dragon's Vanguard' and levels 4 to 6 in the upcoming 'Reign of the Dragon King.'

[h3][b]<2024 Summer Swimwear>[/b][/h3]
The 2024 summer swimwear costumes that many Agents have been eagerly waiting for are almost here!

We are giving you a sneak peek at Seha in this costume and hope you’re as excited as we are.
 
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c82b8d4e46c8aff4d223a57ed2670040b2f41e15.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Seha 2024 Summer Swimwear Illustration (Normal)[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/824de39a02299c13645cc0169857845e4f26fa66.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Seha 2024 Summer Swimwear Illustration (Special)[/b][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][September 11th][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<Summer Dungeon: Reign of the Dragon King>[/b][/h3]
Following the 'Dragon's Vanguard', the main story of 'Reign of the Dragon King' will be updated.

In this dungeon, you will encounter 'Astarte the Dragon Queen' and 'Hecatoncheir, the Dragon King', whom we introduced earlier. 

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b1f61a3ba37a938c77435bac21d14a79b1a7dca4.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Astarte the Dragon Queen[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
The main objective of this quest is to uncover the connections between the new epic monster Astarte and the characters Astarte and Astaroth, as well as the events involving them.

Particularly, figuratively speaking, the previous form of 'Hecatoncheir' can be considered an undead state.

For those curious about his strength if he were alive, this update will let you experience his might and majesty from the era of the Dimensional War, revisiting his memories from the past in Western Europe.

We hope you look forward to how the story of the Dragon King will unfold.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/049bfc6aee5ef34b79ebf2e85e286a4fabbd7814.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Cradle of Dragons Dungeon[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
In the <Cradle of Dragons>, where Astarte appears, the battle will involve preventing the Dragon Legion from intervening to protect Astarte. The battle dynamics can change based on your choices, promising a variety of fun strategic approaches.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b2ec30e64eab2892e11997e18e7feb346325ee80.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Cradle of Dragons Dungeon and Astarte[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
In <Paris under Dragon’s domination>, battles involve breaking the Dragon King Hecatoncheir's shields while removing debuffs. The combat is designed around the basic Closer's fight mechanics of dodging and attacking, with additional gimmick to keep the experience enjoyable and less burdensome.

In 'Reign of the Dragon King,' you will be able to farm Epic Core and Extra Core.

We previously mentioned that a craft recipe for untradable Extra Core will be introduced. This untradable Extra Core will be added to be craftable from Epic Core by ‘Upgrade’.

This will allow you to transfer settings from Epic Cores to the new untradable Extra Cores, improving the convenience of gear farming.

Tradable Extra Cores will still be obtainable through dungeon play as before.

[h3][b]<Bonus Reward System>[/b][/h3]
Starting with the Reign of the Dragon King dungeon, a new reward system called 'Bonus Rewards' will be implemented.

'Bonus Rewards' are additional rewards granted separately from regular drops and clear rewards. These are given immediately upon clearing the dungeon under specific conditions that qualify for ‘Bonus Rewards’. Once the limit for 'Bonus Rewards' is reached, no further rewards will be given until the reward count is reset.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/49e9a7b214d900e9496e88542c36db84eba65539.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Extra Rewards System[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
The 'Bonus Rewards' system automatically collects rewards after clearing a dungeon without needing to press the 'Receive Reward' button, making gameplay more convenient. This system will initially apply to the 'Reign of the Dragon King' dungeon and is planned to be expanded to most dungeons that Agents frequently play in the future.

Additionally, this system will also be applied to existing dungeons, with more details to be announced later.

This is expected to alleviate issues where players could miss out on rewards due to unexpected errors or using up all of their Resurrection Capsules before clearing the dungeon.
 
[h3][b]<Enhancement Renewal>[/b][/h3]
Many Agents have been curious about the renewal of the enhancement system, and I'd like to provide further information on it.

Here is a brief recap of the previously explained details:
[olist][*]The enhancement buff system will be removed.[/*][*]Enhancement chances provided by enhancement buffs will be incorporated into the base chances.[/*][*]Guaranteed enhancement points will be acquired upon failure or no change in enhancement status.[/*][*]Once guaranteed enhancement points reach a certain threshold, the next enhancement attempt will succeed with a 100% chance.[/*][/olist]
Additionally, I would like to pre-announce the following updates.
[olist][*]Absolute Gear Booster can be used up to the expanded enhancement range, (up to right before the maximum enhancement level of +30)[/*][*]Failure chance will be removed up to the +17 enhancement level (up to the attempt from +16 to +17)[/*][/olist]
We are diligently preparing to introduce an enhancement system that makes more sense.
 

[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][September 25th][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<3rd Memorial Quest>[/b][/h3]
As previously shared on the last Closers Channel ON, the story 'The Man's Stopped Time' featuring Tina and Trainer, is prepared as the third memorial quest.

We hope you look forward to discovering how this previously unknown chapter of their past unfolds.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/60e81ce0d3a3351928ea9cb8a78ee88583972b53.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]Trainer and Tina's Talkface (Modified)[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
We are also preparing special costumes related to the story of the memorial quest, so we hope you will enjoy it.
 
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ba59b63be89d11a2d2f599165682ebda2faf3840.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Memorial Entry[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
Additionally, a new entry exclusive to the Memorial Quest will be introduced with the update of the third Memorial Quest.

[h3][b]<Balance Patch>[/b][/h3]
We are also preparing a balance patch for approximately four characters.
[color=#c3a3ff]([i]Note: The number of characters affected may vary depending on the development progress[/i])[/color]

This balance patch will focus on adding 'utility' as the key point and aim to enhance the damage output for some characters.

We strive to ensure that the adjusted characters will show significant improvements in both convenience and damage.

[h3][b]<Yoon Ria Skill Polish>[/b][/h3]
The final update for Ria character, 'Skill Polish,' will be added.

While we cannot reveal which skills will be subjected to the Polish target just yet, we are committed to developing changes that will give you more enjoyable skill combinations to experience.


[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][October 8th][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<Teacher Young-Yi's Divine Battle>[/b][/h3]
Finally, Teacher Young-Yi returns with the Divine Battle!

Previously, the Divine Battles were hosted by the Dogra and Magra sisters, but this time, Teacher Young-Yi will take over their roles.

We'd like to give you a heads-up that we might also rename the Divine Battle to align with this update.
 
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/50c624a6133a18f2cc7e5f9240d425caad97031d.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Teacher Young-Yi's Talkface[/b]
[/td][/tr][/table]
The concept for this Divine Battle event dungeons is 'endless waves of monsters and non-stop barrage of skills.'

We plan to present this fun combat against numerous dimensional monsters in a new style, ensuring the gameplay is optimized to avoid any frame drops. We look forward to your participation and hope you enjoy the new challenges.

[list][*]Some of the content above is under development and is subject to change upon update.[/*][/list]
[h3][b][The End][/b][/h3]
We've mainly shared major content updates today, but we are also working on various other improvements as well.

We will provide more information on the details that have not yet been finalized in future updates.

That concludes the information we've prepared for today.

We are committed to meeting your expectations and ensuring Closers remains a game you’re excited to engage with.

Thank you.
Sincerely, Hyun-Jun Kang

notes.title: April 11th Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Break Challenge[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Contents ‘Break Challenge’ has been added. [/b][/color]
[list]
[*]‘Break Challenge’ Dungeon can be entered by the new NPC <Break Challenge Entry - Queen> at ‘Noah's Museum’ Town.
[*]Entry NPC <Break Challenge Entry - Queen> is displayed to the character of 95lv or higher who has cleared the ‘And Holy Lance’ Quest.
[*]‘Break Challenge’ contents have been added to the Game Farming Guide, UNION Watch - Dungeon Mission, and Achievement. 
[list][*]‘Break Challenge’ Achievement Main Reward: ‘Name Tag Ticket: Signet of the One who Chained Up Gluttony’, ‘Glutton King's Trigger Random Box’[/list]
[/list][color=#ffae42][b]▶ 4 types of ‘Break Challenge: Fly King’ themed Dungeon have been added. [/b][/color]
[list]
[*]‘Break Challenge: Fly King’ themed 3 Elite Dungeons and 1 Challenge Dungeon have been added. 
[*]‘Infinite Gluttony ticket’, which is the entrance material for Challenge Dungeon, is acquirable from Elite Dungeon. 
[*] 3 types of Break Challenge Elite Dungeon can proceed consecutively when clearing the dungeon, by [Proceed to Next Ops]. 
[*] Elite Dungeon [Proceed to Next Ops] Order:  Campus of Singing Deception → Flesh-eating Streets → Island of the Strong
[/list]
[b][Dungeon Information][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/de34b636d4a45a5db80812d38471d28a7b0fa5ce.png[/img]
[i]*Basic Resurrection Restriction count is 3 times and Basic limit time is 5 minutes, without proceeding to ‘Chapter of Infinite Gluttony’ Challenge Dungeon's restriction adjustment. [/i]

[b][Clear Rank Reward by Dungeon][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a0c532ddbe520a9dd78c76491cc0b8a8b727d58f.png[/img]
[i]*[color=#5f95cc]Clear Rank Reward[/color] can be acquired at a set probability depending on the clear rank.[/i]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Restriction Adjustment System has been added to the ‘Break Challenge’ Dungeon. [/b][/color]
[list][*]Challenge Dungeon of ‘Break Challenge’ can adjust the dungeon difficulty by restriction adjustment, and the acquirable point is changed when clearing the dungeon depending on that. [/list]
[b][Restriction Adjustment Details][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/451ee168708a3e1e0c5b3b307f0c9254b28f0d17.png[/img]
[i]*Depending on the restriction adjustment, some abilities in the character information window > Details within the dungeon may appear as negative numbers or the character's damage may be applied as 0.[/i]

Please note that this is a result based on restriction adjustment and is not an error when using the game.
[list][*]The acquired challenge Point from Dungeon Clear is not accumulated but will be renewed as the Best Point within the period. 
[*]Acquired challenge Points can be checked at 'My Point', at the bottom left of the dungeon entrance screen.  
[*]Point Reward is acquirable according to the obtained challenge Point. 
[*]Main Point Reward Item: Glutton King's Trigger Box (Epic),  Glutton King's Memory Crystal, Chromatic Phase Essence, Sticky Residue
[*]Point Reward is acquirable per challenge point reward, once per character.
[*]Challenge Point and Reward acquire count is reset on every Saturday at AM 4:00.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. New Trigger[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 2 types of New Trigger have been added. [/b][/color]
[list]
[*]‘Gluttony Execution’, and ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’ Trigger are acquirable by playing Break Challenge ‘Challenge Dungeon’ or crafting and opening ‘Glutton King's Trigger Random Box’. 
[*]‘Gluttony Execution’, and ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’ Triggers are acquired with an unappraised status when initially acquired, and Tuning Option and Fixed Granted Option are granted when proceeding with Identify Item.  
[/list]
[b][2 types of Trigger][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d380b5ee17ebc0457e598655837696994df43013.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Trigger Fixed Granted Option has been added. [/b][/color]

[list]
[*]Trigger Fixed Granted Option Item: ‘Gluttony Execution’, ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’
[*]Fixed Granted Option is at the top of the Tuning Option, and a total of 10 options are available with grades of 6 (Grade 1~6).  
[*]The probability of the appearance of all fixed granted options and grades is the same, and the same options can be obtained as duplicates.
[*]The fixed granted option cannot be checked on an item that is in an unappraised state and can be checked when appraising the item (identify item).
[/list]
[b][Fixed Granted Option Type and Grade][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/17eace38ad8ea936ec8accc609cc2e915e4abb3f.png[/img]

[b][Glutton King's Trigger Box Specification][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/438e68e019c7e78cf26c5c3b234738a4326f2379.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Trigger Tuning Transfer[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Trigger Tuning Transfer System has been added.[/b][/color]

[list]
[*]‘Trigger Tuning Transfer’ is a system that allows you to transfer the tuning option of a trigger to another trigger.
[*]Available items for Trigger Tuning Transfer: ‘Gluttony Execution’, ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’
[*]It can be proceeded by right-clicking the New Consumables Item ‘Trigger Tuning Extractor’ for Trigger Tuning transfer, or NPC <Crafting/Salvaging/Tuning Transfer - Allan>.
[*]Tuning information of ‘Extract Target Gear’ can be transferred to ‘Transfer Target Gear’ at the Tuning Transfer System window. 
[*]When Tuning transfer, Credits and ‘Trigger Tuning Extractor’ Item is consumed.  
[*]When Tuning transfer, ‘Extract Target Gear’ is destroyed, and the tuning count of ‘Transfer Target Gear’ remains the same as before tuning.
[*]While using the tuning transfer system, Item Remove, Sort, Appraisal, Costume Locker Open, and Search functions cannot be used.
[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Trigger Fuel System Removal[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Trigger Fuel System has been removed. [/b][/color]

[list]
[*]The effect activated through Trigger fuel activation has been transferred to the Basic Option.
[*]The Original Trigger ON/OFF button has been changed to a preset button.
[*]The supply source where trigger combustion can be obtained has been removed from existing content.
[list][*]Craft machine - Trigger Combustion Recipe, NPC Shop, Monster drop, Reward and more[/list]
[*]‘Trigger Combustion’ and ‘Trigger Combustion - Boost’ Items have been changed to be available for sale at the shop. 
[*]The ‘Trigger Combustion - Epic’ Item has been changed to be unavailable to trade on the Black Market.
[list][*]Items registered in the black market before the maintenance on 4/11 (Thursday) will be rejected after the maintenance. You must receive the rejected 'Trigger Combustion - Epic’ item to re-register the items in bulk.[/list]
[*]The New Craft recipe has been added for the 'Break Challenge Trigger Material Selectable Box' that uses the ‘Trigger Combustion - Epic’ Item as a material.
[*]The ‘Gluttony King’s Memory Crystal’ item has been sent by mail according to the trigger fuel figure activated before the maintenance on 4/11 (Thursday).

[*]Trigger Fuel System-related contents have been removed from the game guide. 
[*]Some of the UNION Watch missions have been changed according to the removal of the Trigger Fuel System.
[list][*]Changes: Daily/Weekly Mission - Trigger Fuel Charge → Skill use, Item Craft, Chip Overclock[/list]
[/list][h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. Item Appraising System Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Item Appraising System (Identify items) has been improved.  [/b][/color]

[list]
[*]Item appraising effect pops up when right-clicking the unappraised item has been removed. 
[*]When clicking the [Identify Item] button in the inventory, the total appraised cost of all unappraised items in the inventory is now displayed.
[*]Appraisal of items in inventory has been changed to be completed immediately once pressing the OK button in the appraised price combined cost information window.
[/list]

[list][*]When the upgrade is successful, the conditions for the message output to all servers have been changed. (Success at level 7 → Success at level 10)[/*][*]Some contents of the guide related to ‘Fused Phase Wings’ have been modified.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Fiber Shop Addition[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ [Fiber Shop] has been added to NPC Shop.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Character of above level 80 can use ‘Fiber Shop’ from <Shop - Pheasant> NPC > Normal Shop.[/*][*]You can exchange ‘Common Phase Fiber’, ‘Splendid Phase Fiber’ Item into ‘Phase Wings Essence’, ‘Costume Fusion Fiber’, ‘Special Agent/Special Crew/Hireling Costume Full Set’, ‘3-star Accessory Item Full Set’ and more.[/*][*]All items acquired from the Fiber Shop’ cannot be traded on the black market, and some items cannot be moved to the account storage.[/*][*]Some costumes and accessory items obtained from the ‘Fiber Shop’ are acquired in a state that cannot be repackaged.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Addition of PNA system Awakended Gene[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ A total of 14 types of Awakened Gene A, B, and C of the PNA system Awakening strain have been added.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The number of awakening material capsules that can be obtained in one play in Gremory Dungeon has been increased.[/b][/color][list][*]Target Dungeon: Advanced Central Laboratory, Bear Land, Gremory Science Facility (Each includes [V.HARD])[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Dungeon Reward acquire improvement[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ To improve dungeon play and reward acquisition, some dungeon rewards have been removed or added.[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f5783d1319a584246a4fb598ea1ebbf16e8a492e.png[/img]
[list][*]If there was a party clear reward in the ‘Reward Removal Dungeon’, the party clear reward has been changed to a reward for obtaining a drop from defeating a boss monster.[/*][*]Main Reward Item: Gear Booster Fuel I, Fast Dual Recovery Capsule, Malek Crystal, Common Phase Fiber, Pet Food etc.[/*][*]The amount of ‘Malek Diamond’, the main reward item in the Flame Wave 4-person mission dungeon, has been increased.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some changes have been made to Gremory Dungeon reward items and acquisition methods.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Drop reward items in some Gremory Dungeons have been changed to improve convenience in using inventory space.[/*][*]Target Dungeon: Advanced Central Laboratory, Bear Land, Gremory Science Facility (Each includes [V.HARD])[/*][*]Major changes: Credit → Gold Malek Statue /  PNA Evolution Additives → Unified as Doctor's Secret Box / Various Evolution & Mutation Material Capsule → Unified as Standard Evolution/Mutation Material Capsule.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. Addition and Improvement of Pet System Features[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ An Exclusive Pet registration function for each Dungeon Armor Type has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can register the exclusive pet for each dungeon armor type in Pet Information > Container.[/*][*]When you click the ‘Exclusive Pet Registration Button’ displayed at the top left of the pet you wish to register in the pet container, you can register the pet as a dedicated pet that matches the dungeon armor type.[/*][*]When you left-click a registered exclusive pet in the reaction type dedicated pet window, detailed information about the pet is displayed, and when you right-click, the dedicated pet is deactivated.[/*][*]Only one dedicated pet can be registered for one reaction type.[/*][*]The same pet can be registered as a dedicated pet in multiple reaction types.[/*][*]If you hover your mouse over the ‘Quick Change’ button in the armor type dungeon entry guide UI, you can check the registered pets dedicated to the reaction type of the corresponding dungeon.[/*][list][*] By clicking the ‘Quick Change' button, you can quickly replace the pet with a registered reaction type exclusive pet.[/list][*]The ‘Quick Change’ button can only be used in armor type dungeons. (Not displayed in normal/special operations area/matrix dive/party pop-up.)[/*][*]Reaction Type Exclusive Pet List is saved and shared on an account basis.[/*][*]If it is registered as a dedicated pet, Pet Salvage, Evolution, or Enhancement of the pet is not available.[/*][*]When Pet Enhancement, a pet registered as a dedicated pet is not exposed to Enhancement Material.[/*][*]Information regarding Exclusive Pet registration has been added to the Guide.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Pet Skill automatic change function has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]If a pet active skill is equipped in the skill slot, the pet's active skill is automatically changed when the pet changes.[/*][*]After equipping a pet active skill in a skill slot, if you equip a pet without an active skill or do not equip a pet, the skill slot will be displayed as an empty icon.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Other Pet System usage conveniences have been improved.[/b][/color]
[list][*]‘Pet Nametage/Automatic Item Effect Hide’ function's name has been changed to ‘Turn off pet UI Effects’.[/*][*]When ‘Turn off Pet UI Effects’, Pet Stamina Cooldown guage bar and phrase to guide Pet Evolution including Pet Nametag/Automatic Item effect hide will not be displayed.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6. Character Balance Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ All Characters' some skill balance have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Some skills' options and tooltips have been changed.[/*][*] The coefficients of some skills have been adjusted.[/*][/list]

notes.title: February 28th Update Patch Notes [Updated]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. New Town <World Peace Plaza> & <Origin Wheel>[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Town ‘World Peace Plaza’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]‘World Peace Plaza’ is the next story area after 'Command and control room, New Seoul branch'.[/*][*]You can accept ‘Gathering Flames’ quest from <Miniwheel> at Command and Control room, New Seoul branch Town and play it after completing ‘Concluded’ Quest with the character of 92Level or above.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Town ‘Origin Wheel’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can enter ‘Origin Wheel’ Town by accepting ‘Behind the Broadcast’ Quest from <Simon Park> NPC after completing ‘Unexpected Uninvited Guest’ quest at World Peace Plaza Town with the character of 92 level or above.[/*][*]‘World Peace Plaza’ and ‘Origin Wheel’ can be transferred to each other through ‘Origin Wheel Transfer Beam’ in Town by accepting the Behind the Broadcast Quest.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘World Peace Plaza’ Area Dungeons have been added.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3fac88276e6f7287055fc3ecec02964981ae3a66.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Season 4 Update and New Town ‘World Peace Plaza’ related other updates.[/b][/color]
[list][*]World Peace Plaza Area Progress Reward has been added.[/*][*]Season 4 Channel has been added.[/*][list][*] You can acquire additional exp by playing dungeons in ‘World Peace Plaza’, ‘Origin Wheel’ Area from Season 4 Channel.[/list][*]‘World Peace Plaza’ has been added to Crew Reputation.[/*][*]Dungeon clear mission in ‘World Peace Plaza’ Area has been added to Crew Weekly/Daily mission.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. New Operation Area <Operation: Flame Wave>[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Operation Area <Operation: Flame Wave> has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can enter ‘Operation: Flame Wave’ by <Origin Wheel situation monitor> NPC at ‘Origin Wheel’ Town, after completing ‘And Holy Lance’ Quest from <Soohyun> NPC.[/*][*]Characters of level 95 can participate ‘Operation: Flame Wave’.[/*][*]‘Operation: Flame Wave’ is divided into ‘1-player (single) Mission’ and ‘4-players Mission’, which can be opened by entrance UI from <Origin Wheel Situation Monitor> where you can check dungeon type, clear reward, and entrance restriction count.[/*][*]You can change the mission and reward by [Refresh] at ‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon.[/*][*][Refresh] is available once a day for free and will require credit consumed after that.[/*][*][Refresh] will not renew ‘4-players Mission’.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0c709704fc0e70dd3a2dfaf58ec8300ddf2c0528.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘1-player (Single) Mission’ Dungeon is consisted of 12 types.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/38df98f52d4945a31bb0dd32bc9bc1c8f938d7ad.png[/img][list][*]The ‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon is available according to each rate, and when you clear it and receive the reward, another ‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon becomes available on the map depending on the rate.[/*][*]If there are acquirable clear rewards at the ‘1-player(single) Mission’ Dungeon, player cannot enter another ‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon.[/*][*]‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon can no longer be entered once the available number of rewards received reaches 0.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘4 players Mission’ Dungeon consists of 3 types.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3cf42bf5dfdb1c6356996f887354c172c466ec0d.png[/img]
[list][*]In ‘4-players Mission’ Dungeon, each fixed dungeon appears for each day of the week.[/*][*]The <New Seoul Boss Box>, which can be obtained when clearing the ‘4-person mission’ dungeon, allows you to obtain the following items depending on the probability when opened.
: Chromatic Phase Essence, Sticky Residue, Normal D Component: Gear, Splendid D Component: Gear, Normal D Component: Costume, Splendid D Component: Costume, Gear Booster Fortifier, Perfect PNA Evolution Kit, Overclock Chip[/*][*]When entering ‘Mirror Hell: Crossroads’ Dungeon, you will be entered into ‘One-eyed Chaser: Kang Lim’ or ‘Mirror Paradise: Bihyung’ Dungeon according to the set rate.[/*][*]‘4-players Mission’ Dungeon is recommended to proceed with 4 players, and there is no restriction on the number of entrances. However, after receiving a reward, Entrance and Retry are available, but receiving additional rewards is not available.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ <Operation: Flame Wave> Rewards have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]The number of times you can obtain the ‘Operation: Flame Wave’ Reward applies to each character.[/*][*]The number of times you can obtain ‘Operation: Flame Wave’ rewards is reset every day at 4:00 AM UTC.[/*][*]The number of times ‘4-players Mission’ reward can be obtained is once per day and is charged a maximum of once.[/*][*]‘1 player (single) Mission’ Reward acquirable count’ is charged 3 times daily when logging in, and accumulatively charged up to a maximum of 6 times.[/*][/list]※ Some reward items do not match the trade specification information listed in the tooltip.
You can check the actual Trade Specification by hovering your mouse over the ⓘ icon next to ‘Receive Reward’ in the Clear Reward area in the Flame Wave Entrance UI.


[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Scavenger Reward has been added to <Operation: Flame Wave> Dungeon.[/b][/color]
[list][*]5 types of Scavengers are available depending on the probability when entering ‘Operation: Flame Wave' Dungeon, and you can acquire rewards by defeating it.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8692c0c633b6a8ec2d075500c7d61b4013f3fbeb.png[/img]


[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Gate Wave Dungeon Specification has been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]<Operation: Gate Wave> [Party] Dungeon has been changed to ‘Gate Wave: Subjugation’ Dungeon.[/*][*]One of the monsters among ‘Mirror Grabber Nitocris’, ‘Lightning Kiten’, and ‘Yod's Domain’ appears at ‘Gate Wave: Subjugation’ Dungeon, and Golden Scavenger doesn't appear.[/*][*]‘Gate Wave: Subjugation’ Dungeon can be entered by <New Seoul Branch Situation Monitor> NPC at ‘Command and Control Room, New Seoul Branch’, or <Combined Dungeon Entry - Gaston> NPC at ‘Noah's Museum’ Area.[/*][*]‘Gate Wave: Subjugation’ Dungeon Specification[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b9007b6a75fa2e31f4356a71b406a54443c7cfff.png[/img][list][*]Dungeon Main Rewards[/*][list][*] Guaranteed drop Reward when defeating boss: Induced sleep ticket, UNION tactics analysis file, UNION battle analysis report.[/*][*] Gear Craft/Upgrade Material Drop has been doubled up compared to before.[/*][*] Dungeon Clear Rate Reward: Program bio-verification key.[/*][*] The existing <Operation: Gate Wave> 1-player dungeon and [Party] dungeon missions will end, and mission rewards can be obtained through <Operation: Flame Wave>.[/*][/list][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The contents below have been modified in accordance with the addition of <Operation: Flame Wave> and changes to the dungeon specifications of <Operation: Gate Wave>.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Content related to <Operation: Gate Wave> has been deleted from the in-game guide, and content related to <Operation: Mission> has been added.[/*][*]NPC <New Seoul Branch Remote Monitor - Edgar EX> has been deleted from ‘Noah’s Museum’ and ‘The end: The world in flames’ towns.[/*][*]NPC <Origin Wheel Remote Monitor - Edgar EX> has been added to ‘Noah's Museum’ and ‘The end: The world in flames’ Town.
You can play the ‘Operation: Flame Wave’ dungeon through this entry.[/*][*]UNION Watch Dungeon Mission has been added. (Order: Flame Wave)[/*][/list]

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]3. New battle pattern <Dimension distortion field>[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New battle pattern <Dimension distortion field> has been added. [/b][/color]

- Dimension distortion field is a combat pattern that opens and activates its power when a monster protected by the Flame Sanctuary reaches a certain level of stamina.  

- When the Dimension Distortion Field is activated, a shield spreads around the monster, and the durability of the shield is displayed in a gauge bar above the monster's head.

- The durability of the dimension distortion field's shield can be consumed by damaging it with attacks, and when attacking in a phase awakening state, the durability of the shield is consumed quickly.  

- When the type of phase awakening is high, the damage that goes into the shield of the Dimension distortion field increases. 

- The monster's next action is determined depending on whether the shield is destroyed within the time limit.

- The durability level of the shield increases when playing in a party. 

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Dimension distortion field guide has been added to the in-game help (H). [/b][/color]

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]5. ‘Post-processing effect’ function [/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Game screen filter function, ‘Post-processing effect’ has been added.[/b][/color]

- You can see the Post-processing effect settings pop-up window by clicking the [Post-processing effect] button in the fixed menu at the bottom, after clicking the [Menu] button or pressing the [ESC] key to open the quick menu.

- The [Post-processing effect] button has been added to the bottom fixed menu, and the existing [Guide] menu button has been moved to page 2 of the top menu list.

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Detail control function of ‘Post-processing effect’ has been added. [/b][/color]

- You can adjust the source of light, depth of field and color calibration at Post-processing effect setting popup window.

- Post-processing settings are saved regardless of the character and need to be reset when changing the PC. 

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]6. Game Screen Filter Function [/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ A sharpness adjustment option has been added to the game screen filter function ‘Post-processing effect’.[/b][/color]

- You can set sharpness options in the pop-up window that opens when you click the [Post-processing effect] button at the bottom of the game quick menu (ESC).

- The sharpness option can be set with ON/OFF.

- When you set the sharpness option as ON, a bar for setting detailed values will be activated and you can save the settings by pressing the [Apply] button.

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]7. New Passive Skill 'Polish' Update [/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ A new passive skill ‘Polish’ has been added. [/b][/color]

- The new passive skill ‘Polish’ can be opened and learned when each character is promoted to Prime Agent/Fatal Crew/Shadow Agent.

- When learning the ‘Polish’ passive skill, ‘Polish’ can be applied to two active skills for each character. However, in order to apply the polish effect, the target active skill must be acquired to the maximum level.

- Acquiring the ‘Polish’ passive skill and activating the target skill's passive activation does not consume SP.

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ A passive function has been added that allows you to apply 'Polish' to two active skills for each character. [/b][/color]

- When you activate the Target Skill Polish passive in the Skill > Passive tab, the polish effect is applied to the Target Skill.

- When attacking by using the active skill with applied Polish, additional attack might be available or the skill coefficient might be increases depending on the skill. 

- When attacking by using the active skill with applied Polish, Air Strike/Back Attack/Chase guaranteed judgments are applied to the attack added through polish.  

- Attacks added through polish are not affected by skill level.  

-  To view the detailed information of skill coefficients of the additional attack when applying the polish passive, please head over to our [url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/october-25th-update-patch-notes-826]Official Website.[/url]
