notes.title: October 4th Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Contents[/b][/h2]

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]1. PNA System Renewal[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ PNA and mutant systems are integrated into account-based.[/b][/color]

[color=#d4a1f0]1) Integration Changes[/color]

- EXP for each type of PNA and mutant held on a per-character basis have been integrated on an account basis.
[list][*] All mutation materials consumed in the existing variant system are combined and refunded to your account.[/list]
- All PNA genes of Attack/Defense/Support/Special/Amplifier Strains in PNA system have been integrated into the Account basis.

- Evolution/Enhancement/Mutation materials are shared on an account basis and the maximum holding quantity is expanded. (Maximum possession quantity of each material is 999,999) 

- In accordance with the system reorganization, the tooltips for enhancement/evolution material items and PNA material consumables have been changed.


[color=#d4a1f0]2) Changes to opening conditions[/color]

- PNA and mutation opening conditions have been changed.
[list]
[*] PNA Open: Open when a character on your account reaches level 51 for the first time.    
[*] Mutant Open: Open when reaches account PNA level 80.   
[*] The PNA and mutant systems are open to all characters without any restrictions after initial opening.[/list]
[color=#d4a1f0]3) PNA Quest Changes[/color]

- Due to PNA account integration, some related quests have been changed or deleted.

- All PNA-related achievements except ‘Succeed with PNA evolution’ have been deleted.

- All Gremory Dungeon quests have been changed to be available when level 87 or higher.
[list]
[*] The PNA system opens when a character in your account reaches level 51 for the first time, but PNA growth is available with characters of level 87 or higher.  
[*] PNA quests in progress before the maintenance on Oct 4th will be canceled and can proceed again after level 87. (If you have already completed it, there is no need to proceed again)
[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New content [Awakening Strain] has been added to the PNA system. [/b][/color]

- The Awakening Strain tab has been added to the PNA window.    

- Three types of awakening material types A, B, and C, and three types of Awakening Gene types A, B, and C have been added.  

- In the Awakening Strain tab, you can equip up to 3 awakening genes by right-clicking or left-clicking and dragging.  

- The effect of the equipped awakening genes is displayed in the ‘Factor effect’ column of the awakening strain tab.   

- Awakening genes of the same type are displayed with the same icon and cannot be equipped in duplicate.   

- Awakening genes of the same type are displayed in the same color.  

- The synergy effect is activated when two or more awakening factors of the same type are equipped.

- The synergy effect of the equipped awakening factor is always applied.  

- When you click the [PNA Analysis] button, you can check comprehensive information on the awakening factor currently equipped.     

- Left-click on the awakening factor to view detailed information.  

- Selected awakening factors can be upgraded with awakening materials, and factors that will not be used can also be dismantled.  

- About the types of awakening genes, and their abilities according to the upgrade stage.


[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Mutant system has been reorganized.[/b][/color]

[color=#d4a1f0]1) Levels and abilities for each type[/color]

- The maximum level of each Mutant type has been expanded. (Lv.20 → Lv.75)

- EXP required to level up each type of Mutant has been changed.

- The name displayed when a Mutant level up or reaches level MAX has been changed. (Example: VERUS → IRREGULAR)

- The damage increase stat for each Mutant type has been changed to apply at all times.

- ‘Total Mutant Level’, which is the sum of the levels for all Mutant types, is displayed at the top of the Mutant system window.


[color=#d4a1f0]2) Variant reorganization[/color]

- Variant has been reorganized.
[list]
[*] Variants are displayed at the top, and Variant stats have been changed to be always applied when the Mutant system is opened.
[/list]
[color=#d4a1f0]3) Manifestation Body Added[/color]

- 15 Manifestation Bodies have been added.

- Manifestation Body can be opened whenever the total Mutant level reaches a certain number.

- However, if the preceding Manifestation Body is not opened, opening the next Manifestation Body is not available.

- Manifestation Body can be opened using credits and mutation materials, and stats are given according to each probability as soon as it is opened.

- Manifestation Body stats are added and displayed in ‘Manifester stat’ at the top of the UI.

- Manifestation Body stat option: C~SS grade

- Manifestation Body stats can be changed by clicking the [Manipulate] button. [Manipulate] consumes mutant materials.   

- When manipulating the Manifestation Body, it is possible to acquire stats ranging from C to SS option grade depending on each probability.  

- The number of Manifestation Body manipulations is 10 times, shared by all Manifestation Bodies.

- The available number of Manifestation Body manipulations is shared by all Manifestation Bodies.

- If you have consumed all possible Manifestation Body manipulation counts, you can reset the count by consuming the ‘Perfect PNA Evolution Kit’.


[color=#d4a1f0] 4) Mutation material conversion reorganized[/color]

- The amount of goods consumed at the final stage of the mutation material conversion system using 
enhancement/evolution materials and at each stage have been changed.

- The overload level has been expanded from a total of 4 to 8 levels.

- As the overload level increases, the materials and credits consumed increase.


[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New materials and consumable items have been added.[/b][/color]

- Test/Standard/Greater Awakening material A/B/C capsule: Acquire each type of awakening material

- Awakening Genes A/B/C Random Ampoule : Acquire one type of awakening Genes of each type according to each probability

- PNA/Phase Force Growth Activator: Acquire PNA/Character EXP when using


[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Special strain samples have been added and some specifications have been changed.[/b][/color]

- Special Strain samples have been added.

- Special strain samples can be purchased Shop > Support Shop at <Shop - Vending Machine>. (Once a week per account)

- Specifications have been changed so that special strains can be disassembled.


[h3][color=#377bbf][b]2. Gremory Dungeon[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ A new dungeon, <Gremory Arcade>, has been added.[/b][/color]

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]1. Other Updates / Bug Fix[/b][/color][/h3]

The packaging status of Phase Wings and Footprints will be changed as follows after the regular
maintenance on Oct 4th, 2023.
> Phase wings and footprint items acquired from the shop are obtained in a packaged state.
> Phase wings acquired by crafting and contribution shops is acquired in a bound state.


[h3][color=#377bbf][b]2. Changes[/b][/color][/h3]

▶ The effect displayed when Tina’s character ‘Special Move: Finish them: Orbital strike’ skill is strengthened with Overheat stack has been improved.

▶ Errors with some characters have been corrected.

- An issue where the range of ‘EX Wind Sting’ was narrowed in Harpy character PVP has been fixed.

- An issue where The Harpy character’s ‘Special Skill: Mask of Prom Queen’ buff was not updated using The draw Skill has been fixed.

- An issue where resource acquisition/consumption of Tina’s character ‘Special Move: Finish them: Orbital strike’ skill occurred at abnormal times has been fixed.

- An issue where the ‘Petal slash’ attack of Violet character’s ‘Special Move: Fluttering blade: Bloody rose’ skill was activated before the ‘Thorn slash’ attack has been fixed. 

- An issue where the Seth character ‘EX Nephthys’s Grace’ skill effect was displayed in an abnormal location has been corrected.

- An issue where the skill effect was not visible or had a minimal effect that was difficult to identify when setting the optimization (low spec) in the effect optimization option has been improved.


▶ The time required for the character's knockdown and wake-up motions has been adjusted. 

- The animation speed of some knockdown and wake-up motions has been adjusted. 

- The time for knockdown and wake-up motions to be canceled by using the arrow keys has been adjusted quickly.


▶ The tooltip for Tina’s character EX Sharp Shooting skill has been modified. 

- (Before) 6 Overheat stacks are acquired when a Double Shotgun Finish attack is activated. 

- (After) 6 Overheat stacks are acquired when the skill ends after activating Double Shotgun Finish 

▶ Legion Program: The difficulty of the INFERNAL has been adjusted.


▶ The number of days required for Task Force/Black Hand promotion has been reduced. 
- Number of items required to complete the quest: (Before) 10 → (After) 2


▶ The craft explanation in ‘Awakening marble’ item tooltip has been modified.

- (Before) Awakening marble can be crafted in the [Planar Gate]-craft machine. 

- (After) Awakening marble can be crafted in the craft machine. 


▶ The issue where all skill icons flashed when using a skill has been corrected. 


▶ The skill effects of some characters have been optimized. 


▶ A typo in the helpful dialogue displayed during the battle of ‘Belphegor Investigation Group – Annabelle’ has been corrected.


▶ Effect optimization options have been added.

The rendering optimization option has been removed.

- Effect optimization options can be set from the selection between ‘Basic(high specifications)’ and ‘Optimized(low specifications)’. 

- Dungeon entry/psychic moves/Dungeon clear motions are displayed the same regardless of optimization options. 

- When ‘Optimized(low spec)’ is set in the effect optimization options, some skill effects are not displayed.
※ It has been confirmed that some effects are displayed abnormally when using signature/unique costume-exclusive emotes after setting ‘Optimization (Low Specs)’ in the effect optimization options.
Improvements will be made through additional optimization work in the future, and the detailed schedule will be announced in a separate notice.


▶ Some quest achievement conditions have been improved.

- Some quests that require clearing The same Dungeon more than two times have been adjusted to one time.


▶ [Gremory Arcade] Operation Area 'Fighting game... Teddy fight!’ pattern has eased slightly. 


▶ The Damage Increase option value for each type has been adjusted according to the level of each Mutant type. 

- The Damage Increase option for each Mutant type obtained upon reaching level 20 has been changed. (260% → 270%)  

- After each Mutant type reaches level 20, the increase in Damage Increase option effect for each type according to level up is the same as before. 

 
[h3][color=#377bbf][b]3. Bug Fixes[/b][/color][/h3]
 
▶ The issue where the character’s gaze was directed towards the monster when using the ‘Ultimate Move: Climax’ skill with Cheolsu Kim’s character has been corrected.

▶ The issue where the icon for the skill 'Special Skill: Awaking Nergal' was displayed abnormally when the Lucy character died under 'Nergal's Gaze' 5stacks and was revived has been fixed. 

▶ The issue where Cheolsu Kim’s character '[Mercy] - Dance Macabre' skill's Mark of Judgment increased damage received by 15% debuff was not activated has been fixed.

▶ The issue where the ground and air demons summoned in Lovecraft did not explode when touching the character has been fixed.

▶ The issue where potions could be used in the Night-Maze Dungeon has been fixed.  

▶ An issue where the Nightmare NPC existed for a moment and then disappeared after the door to the next gate was opened in the Nightmare shop area of the 'Night-Maze' dungeon has been fixed.

▶ An issue in the Aeri character ‘Rooftop: Second Half_Very Hard’ dungeon where the Puppet Master, which only appears in quests, appears even in situations where there are no quests has been fixed.

▶ The issue where the teleport gimmick within the dungeon did not activate during the character resurrection motion has been fixed.

▶ [Dungeon] UI - An issue where the number of potions in the same spot as B quick slot is displayed in yellow when the additional hit cooldown timer is activated in quick slot A has been corrected.   

▶ [Dungeon] Erosion: An issue that Glutton King's Core King of Gluttony Beelzebub's skill did not work properly has been fixed. 

▶The issue where the cooldown of [Super Acceleration] skill was not reduced when Lee Seha character [Special Move: Combustion: Fierce lightning and thunder] skill was used has been fixed.

▶ The issue of Soma character’s [Joint skill: Good Fellas] skill being deactivated while using [Special Skill: Mantra] skill has been corrected. 

▶ The issue of monsters being pushed back excessively when using Sylvi character’s [Wormhole Buffer] skill has been corrected.

▶ The issue of monsters being pushed back excessively when using Seth character’s [Atum's Memory] skill has been corrected. 

▶ The issue where the rocket summon effect was displayed in an abnormal location when using Tina's [Special Move: Battlefield] skill has been corrected. 

▶ The issue in which the number of hits of the basic attack decreases when Tina's character's attack speed increases has been corrected. 

▶ The issue where the damage of the Mirae character's [Special Move: Lullaby] skill's wild attack was applied differently on the ground and in the air has been corrected.  

▶ The issue where Violet's awakening strain jump effect was not activated in the enhanced state while using [Special Move: Transcendence] has been corrected.  

▶ The issue where the attack judgment activated in stages 2 and 3 of Tina’s character [Heat Shot] skill is not subject to the advance cube effect has been corrected.

[h2]7. Character resources window System Additional[/h2]

[b]▶ Character resources window System has been added. [/b]

- Character resources window System shows the main buff by each character or current stack's possession.    
- Character resources window System shows buff or stack only related to character skill.
- Character resources window is displayed only when entering dungeon.  
- If character acquires certain buff or stack by using skill, then it will be displayed at character resources window immediately. 
∙ When mouse-over on the activated buff or stack's UI, the corresponding buff or stack name will be displayed. 
- Character resources window is displayed differently depending on the corresponding character's promotion level. 
∙ Buff or stack that can't be acquired on current promotion level will not be displayed. 
- Character resources window can be moved by dragging the UI background or inactivated area.  
∙ Character resources window's position is saved and shared by character class type. 
∙ When entering Chat Command “/cr”, Character resources window will be reset to the basic position. 
∙ By moving character resources window off screen, rerunning the client, re-enterring the dungeon, changing the resolution, it is reset to the basic position. 
- Character resources window activation can be set by Option > Game setting > UI setting
- Resources window by character

notes.title: Notice for DirectX 11 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

[h1]Notice for DirectX 11 Update[/h1]

Hello Agents

We would like to inform everyone that Microsoft DirectX 11 will be updated during the regular scheduled maintenance on April 12, 2023 UTC.

Therefore, we advise all players to install and update their programs for normal game executions after the update. Additionally, the update has called for a temporary deactivation of the HDR function.

[h2][b]► Microsoft DirectX 11[/b][/h2]
After the maintenance on April 12, it will not be possible to run the game with lower versions of DirectX 11. 

[url=https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/topic/how-to-install-the-latest-version-of-directx-d1f5ffa5-dae2-246c-91b1-ee1e973ed8c2]Check your computer’s Direct X version here.[/url]

[url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-US/download/details.aspx?id=35]Install the latest version of DirectX here. [/url]

[h2][b]► Temporary Deactivation of HDR[/b][/h2]
The HDR function found in Options > Screen Settings will be temporarily disabled. 

We have confirmed that the effect color and shapes will look abnormal and irregular depending on the game screen, dungeon location, luminous intensity effect, applied effect and more when the HDR function is operating. This is caused by the incompatibility of several functions of the codes after converting the HDR development code from DirectX 9 to DirectX 11 versions. 

As we are concerned that it will cause great inconvenience to Closers’ gameplay, we will apply a temporary deactivation and will re-design the code in the future to reimplement the HDR function. 
 
We apologise for any inconvenience caused and will make notice of when it will be reactivated. 

Thank you for your understanding.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/url]

Or send us an email to:
support@closersonline.com

notes.title: New Changes to Closers World Server!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

The Closers World Server’s back-end team will see some new changes, with a couple of introductions to make and a fond farewell to bid.

Read their letters below:

[table][tr][td]
[b]Hello Agents,[/b]

I'm happy to greet you all. 
My name is Grace, and I joined Naddic Games as a project manager for Closers World Server. I will do my best to make our Agents enjoy Closers.
I kindly ask for all of your big support and attention.

Not only with my joining, but I also have other news that will come to Closers World Server; There will be changes to operation managers. 
Big and sincere appreciation to our wonderful operation managers, 
Dale, Dwayne, and Angela, hope all of Agents warmly greet new managers to come.

Then see you at the roadmap session and dev QnA soon!

[b][i]Grace[/i][/b]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]
[b]Dear Agents,[/b]

We are writing to convey our heartfelt appreciation for the years we have had the honor of serving as your game masters. What a ride it's been, and we appreciate your unending passion and support during this great adventure in Closers.

We are very grateful for the moments that we had during the events that took place on Discord and Facebook. Also, don't forget about the cosplay contest! We've been amazed by your creativity, hard work, and love for Closers, and it's been an honor to be a part of this community.

Even though our time as game masters has come to an end, we want you to know that we will continue to support Closers and the community that we helped build. As the game develops, we will be here to cheer you on and share in your excitement at taking on new adventures and challenges.

Once again, we want to convey our heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you, especially the Closers Players Council, who were there to bridge your thoughts to us. You all have made our time here special, and we will always remember it fondly. We hope that you continue to make Closers a place of fun and adventure!

Thank you for making our time here so memorable. We will miss you all.

[b][i]Dale, Dwayne & Angela[/i][/b]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]
[b]Hello Agents,[/b]

I am Adeena and I’ll be the new Game Master for Closers’ World server and I’ll be the main point-of-contact moving forward. Please don’t hesitate to reach out to me any time as I would love to help!

I’m supported by my colleagues Joshua, Candice and Stephany and we are all excited to assist you in making your game experience better. We can’t wait to get to know all of you as a community and look forward to building new memories together.

We also owe our thanks to Dale, Dwayne and Angela for their patience, work, and guidance in showing us the ropes as we begin our journey with Closers.

Cheers to the new adventure!

[b][i]Adeena, Joshua, Candice & Stephany[/i][/b]
[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Dungeon Issues Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

It has come to our attention some issues related to the dungeons. Please read the following topics below for details:

[h3][b]Disconnection after using Ultimate Skill[/b][/h3]
We’ve received reports that after using a character’s Ultimate skill, players are being kicked out of the game (with the message “Connection to game server lost.”).

At this time, we have observed that this occurs intermittently. As we do our investigation, any information you can provide, specifically the log files, will be greatly appreciated.

Please provide the following information if you have recently experienced a connection loss while using the ultimate ability:
[list][*] Your “.log” file located in your CLOSERS/Log folder. Kindly provide the log file with the time of disconnection was recorded.
[*] Name of the dungeon were you got disconnected[/list]
Please forward this information to [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url] or [url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url] once you’ve finished gathering these needed data.


[h3][b]Invisible Astaroth Bug[/b][/h3]
It has been reported that Astaroth is not spawning or is invisible by the time it should appear to have been defeated. Also, we have observed that it doesn’t occur everytime. We continue to investigate this situation and appreciate your patience.

Meanwhile, please provide the following information if you have found that Astaroth is currently not spawning or is invisible during your dungeon run:

[list][*] A full screenshot or video of that you encountered this bug during your dungeon run.[list][*] The ‘/time’ or the time and date, as well as your character’s name should be clearly seen.[/list][*] Your “.log” file located in your CLOSERS/Log folder. Kindly provide the log file with the time that you encountered this bug.[/list]
Please forward this information to [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url] or [url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url] once you’ve finished gathering these needed data.

If there are any updates, we will post them on the official website as soon as they become available.

Thank you for your cooperation and please do not hesitate to discuss with us for any other concerns.

notes.title: Pre-Patch Notice for January 11 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We are pleased to inform everyone that after the January 11, 2023 update, there will be renewals in the game.

Please keep the following information in mind:
[list][*][b]Advance Notice: Inability to craft and use Transcendence Stone Item after the Transcendence System Renewal[/b]

[list][*]The Gear Transcendence System will be renamed ‘[b]Upgrade System[/b]‘ following the January 11, 2023 update.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Original Transcendence Stone Item will be unavailable to craft or use after the Upgrade System update.[/*][/list]
[list][*][b]All Transcendence Stone and Condensed Transcendence Stone Items from the Craft Machine NPC Craft List would be removed.[/b][/*][/list]
[list][*][b]Unused Transcendence Stone can be converted into an Extract Box from the craft machine using the existing method or directly into Craft Material Item by right-clicking on the Transcendence Stone Status.[/b][/*][/list]
[list][*][b]Including the [ Condensed Transcendence Stone Extract Box ] item, which will be added as a new craft recipe on January 11, 2023, all Transcendence Stone Extract Boxes will maintain the craft recipe for one year, starting on January 11, 2023. And then, all Transcendence Stone extract Box Craft recipes’ including [ Condensed Transcendence Stone Extract Box ] item will be removed, during the first game update in January 2024.[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[table][tr][td]
[b]     Notes[/b]
[list][*]When a "Condensed Transcendence Stone" is refunded, "Transcendence Stone" will be provided as the quantity will be based on the "Condensed Transcendence Stone Craft Required".[/*][*]The required amount of materials for Transcendence Stone Craft will be refunded by right-clicking ‘Transcendence Stone’.[/*][*]If you used ‘Transcendental Elixir’ to create Condensed Transcendence Stone, you can get a restoration by contacting [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]Naddic Customer Support[/b][/url] within 7 days of the craft day.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]
Further details will be discussed in a separate notice which will be announced along with the update.
[list][*][b]Babel Program First Reward Reset and Reward Renewal[/b]
[list][*]After the maintenance on January 11, 2023 UTC, the receipt status of ‘the first reward’ that can be claimed when first clearing a floor will be reset, and reward items will be renewed.[/*][*]As the Reward receipt status will be reset and rewards will be changed after the January 11, 2023 maintenance, please make sure to check for any unclaimed rewards and receive them all.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Investigation Group Weekly Reward Claim Count and Reward Improvement[/b]
[list][*]After the January 11, 2023 maintenance, the Investigation Group Entrance Day will be removed, allowing players to enter every day.[/*][*][Legion Commander Confrontation : Machine King Belphegor] Investigation Group’s Weekly Reward claim count is 3, and rank rewards will be improved a lot.[/*][*]Please ensure that investigation group rewards are obtained prior to the January 11, 2023 maintenance.[/*][/list][/*][/list]Thank you for your understanding.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url]

Or send us an email to:
[b][url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url][/b]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

Hotfix maintenance will be conducted according to the following schedule per time zone:

[b]Schedule by time zone[/b]
[list][*]October 13 at 6:30 AM – [strike]9:00 AM[/strike] 10:00 AM [b]UTC[/b][/*][*]October 12 at 11:30 PM – October 13 at [strike]2:00 AM[/strike] 3:00 AM [b]PDT[/b][/*][*]October 13 at 1:30 PM – [strike]4:00 PM[/strike] 5:00 PM [b]GMT+7[/b][/*][/list][table][tr][td]
[b]Updates[/b]

► The Unique Synchro Fiber Selectable Box is a 2nd day reward for Jumping Attendance that contains unintended tradeable synchro fibers. During the hotfix, we will remove the incorrect items and provide the right ones as soon as possible.

No adjustments will be made for players who have already consumed the fiber for the costume conversion. However, for those who sold the item on the Black Market without noticing the issue, we will soon provide you with some guidelines.

Our sincere apologies for this unforeseen problem and the repeated server downtime. Due to the Temporary and Hotfix maintenance, we will be providing compensation items during the upcoming scheduled patch update.

► We will be extending the Hotfix maintenance for an hour. The server is expected to be up and running at 10:00 AM UTC.

► As of 9:45 AM UTC, the server is now up and running. Thank you for your patience! Please note that we have removed all incorrect Synchro Fibers registered from Black Market and mailed those sellers the correct one.
[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Sylvi’s ‘Neutron Buster’ Skill has been Improved[/b][/h3][list][*]Superelectron Sphere 4 hit has been changed to Superelectron Sphere (Explosion) 1 hit[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ea6d3df2e05be0055e1a501556186a6b740244a4.png[/img]


[table][tr][td][h3][b] 2. Item Craft Renew                                                                     [/b][/h3][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Item Crafting List in each Hub has been Renewed.[/b][/h3][list][*]Area crafting now can be accessed regardless of the character’s current location.[/*][*]Crafting feature of some NPCs has been integrated.[/*][*]If the crafting item consists of several crafting methods, they will be shown on the right side of the UI[/*][*]Title, Pet, Black Market favorites list has been reset due to the crafting renewal.[/*][/list]
[h3]► [b]New Functions have been Added to the Crafting System.[/b][/h3][list][*]Level search: Search crafting items in Minimum ~ Maximum Level scope.[/*][*]Item search: Search crafting methods for a certain crafting item.[/*][*]Now favorites for crafting can be set per character.[/*][*]Craft Link: If there’s craft method link, arrow mark will be shown.[list][*]Craft method can be checked by double clicking the Material Item[/*][*]A button returning to the previous crafting method will be activated on the right-top by clicking craft Link.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Category Changes[/b][/h3][list][*]Crafting items that can be crafted after completing missions now will be shown in ‘Quest’ Category always. (Except for Module no.666)[/*][*]‘Task Force’ Category at Fantasy World: Dream Theater area has been integrated to the ‘Quest’ Category.[/*][*]‘Awakening Bead’ Item in ‘Housing’ category has been moved to ‘Consumables’ Category.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Some Crafting Item has been Removed.[/b][/h3][list][*]‘Purification Trinket 6 Set Box’ in ‘Planar Gate: Deep Layer’ tab has been removed.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Crafting UI has been Improved.[/b][/h3]


[table][tr][td][h3][b] 3. Chip Farming Eased                                                                                    [/b][/h3][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Origin Chip Farming has been Eased[/b][/h3][list][*]Weekly crafting count for Origin Chip per Material has been increased.[/*][*]Amount of materials for crafting Origin Chip has been decreased.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0e6dad17a9d1b3c63f5c4a5b18ab412551088e8b.png[/img]


[table][tr][td][h3][b] 4. Chatting System Improved                                                                                   [/b][/h3][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3]► [b]Chatting System has been Improved.[/b][/h3][list][*]Adding/Modifying/Removing chatting tab function has been added.[/*][*]Maximum 6 chatting tabs can be added, and name of each tab can enter from 2 to 4 characters.[/*][*]All/squad/Crew/whisper/System tabs are default, and they can be modified or removed.[/*][*] Adding/Modifying/Removing chatting tab and adjusting size/location can be done in hub, housing and crew hangout.[/*][*] Minimize feature has been added to chatting tab and clicking the button will activate/deactivate the tab.[/*][*]Chatting Window size adjustment function has been added. Left-click the right-top corner of the chatting window and drag to change the window size.[/*][*] A button adjusting the location of the chatting window has been added.[/*][*]Chatting command Guide button has been moved to the right-bottom corner.[/*][*]New command /cr has been added. Entering the command will reset the size and location changes of the chatting window.[/*][*]New commands for the crew chatting and whisper chatting have been added.[/*][*]Whisper function has been improved.[list][*]Enter /whisper + [Character Name] and Space Bar to enter whisper chat.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Entering ESC button while writing chat will deactivate chatting window only.[/*][*]Chat history will preserve even after changing the channel.[list][*]However, returning to Character Lobby will reset the history.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[table][tr][td][h3][b] 5. Guide System Renewal                                                                                    [/b][/h3][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Guide System has been Renewed.[/b][/h3][list][*]Guide UI now consists of [Main Category / Sub Category / Page].[/*][*]Search function has been added.[/*][*]When searching with a certain keyword, all subcategories containing the keyword will be shown on the search result page.[/*][/list][h3][b]► Guide now Provides the Latest Content.[/b][/h3]

► An issue displaying an incorrect dungeon information when entering a dungeon after leaving a squad has been fixed.

► Information of the currently equipped pet now can be checked on Dungeon Entry UI.

► An issue that decreased AP of the pet in the pet list UI was displayed incorrectly has been fixed.

► Black Market search feature has been improved and registered items has been forcibly expired.

► An issue that the skill level up effect of the equipped gears is not applied after temporary items expire has been fixed.

► An issue that a character with lower HP wins intermittently when timeout happens in UNION Arena (PVP) has been fixed.

► A pop up to check how many box items to open will now be shown always regardless of the amount in possession.

► Change Phase Kit Item now can be tradeable on the Black Market.
[list][*]Change Phase Kit Item can now be sold to Shop at a price of 450,000 credit.[/*][/list]
► Crafting for Change Phase Kit has been removed.

► Entrance item for Eroding Mist Dungeons has been removed and the dungeon clear rewards have been adjusted.

► ‘Mute Background Master Volume’ function has been added to the Option → Sound menu.
[list][*] When using ‘Mute Background Master Volume’ function, the client will output game sounds only when Closers game window is active.[/list]
► Marking blocked character feature has been added to the squad, Investigation Group, Dungeon loading UI.

► Squad name in the received invitation list will now be shortened considering the UI size.

► An issue that garden growing time remains about 1 minute when using ‘water (reducing 3 hours) to 3-hour plants has been fixed.

► An issue that can block myself has been fixed. If you have blocked yourself, it will be unblocked after the maintenance.

► An issue that scroll function does not work correctly in some of the UIs has been fixed.

► An issue that some skin pack effects does not work intermittently for the costumes in the dress room has been fixed.

► ‘Enhancement/Tuning – Poe’ NPC at ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area now have Transcendence tab.

► The name of <Enhancement/Tuning/Transcendence – Poe ver.13> NPC has been changed to <Enhancement/Tuning – Poe ver.13>.
[list][*]You cannot use gear transcendence feature through the NPC.[/*][/list]
► Gremory Dimensional Gate Entry has been added to the ‘Fantasy World: Dream Theater<<Reverse>>’ Town.

► <Combined Dungeon Entry – Gaston> NPC does not show Gremory related dungeons in the Planar Gate tab anymore.

► Exposure location of the Special Agent/Crew Promotion Dungeon on the entry UI has been adjusted.

► 2 more quick slots have been added (9, 0)

► 0 level skills such as character passive skills will not be shown as mastered.

► An issue that ‘Obelisk Demasia’s Protection’ Buff does not apply when using Seth’s ‘Atum’s Memory’ Skill in the air has been fixed.

► An issue that Prime Agent Seth do not get PVP stats applied has been fixed.

► An issue that casting speed of Seth’s skill ‘Honor of Khepri’ I the air is slower than it is used on the ground has been fixed.

► Nata’s afterimage when using ultimate move has been changed to the appearance wearing Fatal Crew Promotion Costume.

► An issue that the coefficient of ‘[Shub Summoning Attack] damage decrease by 15%’ has been applied incorrectly when using Wolfgang’s Chapter of Teeth/Chapter of Gluttony has been fixed.

► An issue that the voices of Seha’s Cybernetics costume were missing has been fixed.

► In order to fix the incorrect damage of the Lucy’s’ Special Move: Uruk’s Executioner’, hit amount of the skill has been changed from 8 hits to 4 hits.

► Incorrect skill damage of Lucy’s ‘Judge Adad’ Skill has been fixed.

► The tracking scope of the Lucy’s ‘Cheering Ishtar’ skill used in the air is now fixed and has same scope as when it’s used on the ground.

► Seth’s ‘Apophis’s Confinement’ Skill now applies Super Armor longer as it is originally intended.

► An issue that some characters get incorrect skill stun in certain circumstances has been fixed.

► An issue that the protection status was not canceled after a press pattern in the ‘Machine King’s Analysis Lab’ has been fixed.

► An issue that monsters became invincible when receiving damage exceeds the protection barrier during ‘You trifles, kneel!’ pattern in ‘[Nightmare] Ancient Dragon’s Prison Castle’ Dungeon has been fixed.

► Unintended camera Zoom-in when retry some dungeons has been fixed.

► Weekly Entrance of Dragon’s Execution Ground dungeon has been increased from once to twice.

notes.title: June 29th Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3f0d8d6f8c523489f6f9b15fc14167af35584f3c.png[/img]

[h1][b][u]Contents[/u][/b][/h1]

[h3][b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20220629-mock-battle-renewal-update-omega-knight-transmitter/] ▶ Mock Battle Renewal[/url][/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Added 2 new boss type[/b]
[list][*]DEEPSEA Boss, [b]‘Vasuki’[/b][/*][*]INSECTAN Boss, ‘[b]Master of Poison[/b]‘[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]The battle runs on weekly basis from now on.[/b][/*][/list]
 ▶ [b]Squad Matching Improvement[/b]
[list][*][b]Squad Matching System is improved.[/b]
[list][*]You can join a squad from almost anywhere, regardless of channel or town.[/*][*]Clicking Squad Menu(F3) opens a list of created squads, except secret squads.[/*][*]Squads that are full do not appear on the list, but can be searched.[/*][*]Squad name can be from 2 ~ 30 letters.[/*][*]Characters appear in squad info in the order of creation.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Squad Menu(F3) UI is changed.[/b]
[list][*]A function of searching squad name and squad leader is added.[/*][*]Searching a squad has 5 seconds of cooldown.[/*][*]When clicking Squad Menu(F3), squads appear in the order of creation and the searched list is renewed by reopening it in 5 seconds.[/*][*]When opening Squad Menu(F3), the initial list of squads don’t renew automatically before reopening UI after 5 seconds or searching again.[/*][*]Squad Menu(F3) doesn’t open together with the following UI:
UNION CAMP/Selfie Mode/UNION Arena/Investigation Group UI/Chip Inventory/Key Bindings/Character Selection/Channel Change[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Squad Invite System is improved.[/b]
[list][*]‘List of Received Invitations’ in Squad Menu(F3) shows a list of received invitations.[/*][*]‘List of Received Invitations’ is available only when you are not in a squad, and if ‘Block All Squad Invitations’ is activated, you won’t get invitations anymore.[/*][*]There is a cooldown of 15 seconds for a leader to invite a same character.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Investigation Group System is improved.[/b]
[list][*]Regardless of channels and towns, all players can join a created investigation Group.[/*][*]When opening the Investigation Group menu, the list shows Investigation Groups in the order of creation, and there is a cooldown of 5 seconds when successful joining through auto matching.[/*][*]Investigation Group UI that pops up after clearing Investigation Group does show the group leader anymore.[/*][*]Investigation Group UI that pops up after clearing Investigation Group the group leader’s function to move members among squads is removed.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
  ▶ [b]Item Farming Improvement[/b]
[list][*][b]Some recipes are added to Crafting Maching in Busan – Nampo-dong.[/b]
[list][*]Muscular/Devotion Bug Lump can now be crafted with ‘Busan Protection Certificate’.[/*][*]‘Locust Hell’ gears can be exchanged with ‘Transcendent Locust Hell’ gears.[/*][*] Materials for ‘Go, Scarlet Scorpions!’ title are changed.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Farming in [Meet with Legion Commander : Lust King Asmodeus] is improved.[/b]
[list][*]Materials for ‘Ocean King Trigger’ are changed to be easier.[/*][*]Materials for ‘Condensed [Trigger] Ocean King’s Transcendence Stone’ are changed to be easier.[/*][*]Materials for ‘Roughly First-sewn Ocean Clothes’ are changed to be easier.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]The crafting limit for Traitor’s Yoke is removed.[/b][list][*]Recipes for Traitor’s Yoke are trimed down to one as the above change.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
  ▶ [b]Skill Tooltip Improvement[/b]
[list][*][b]Tooltips for several skills are improved.[/b]
[list][*]Some skills of characters become easier to understand.[/*][*]Descriptions for some active skills are changed only while those of Ex, Mastery, Passive, Combat Dodge, and Cancel skills remain the same.[/*][*]But tooltips for Ex, Mastery, Passive skills will be changed later.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]▶[/b] [b]Hair Costume Dyeing System[/b]
[list][*][b]Hair Dyeing system is added.[/b]
[list][*]A system to change your hair costume color is added.[/*][*]Hairs that are available for dyeing show the information in their tooltip.[/*][*]Hairs that are not available for dyeing don’t have the info.[/*][*]An icon of dyed hair shows its changed color.[/*][*]Some hairs cannot be dyed and the list is as follows:[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][td][b][u]Costumes[/u][/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yuri’s Icon Hair (Ver.HW)[/b]
[b]J’s High Tide Helmet[/b]
[b]Davy Jone White Hair[/b]
[b]Yuri’s Icon Hair[/b]
[b]Asmodeus Black & White Hair[/b]
[b]Transparent Dimensional Hat[/b]
[b]Time-Limited Hair[/b][/td][/tr][/table][list][*][b]Hair Costume Bleach system is added.[/b]
[list][*]‘Bleach’ recovers an original color of an hair costume.[/*][*]Bleach costs credit.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]How to Dye/Bleach hair costume[/b]
[list][*]Please follow the instructions below:
1. Use ‘Hair Dyeing Ampoule’ or ‘Selectable Hair Dyeing Ampolue’ in inventory[/*][/list][list]2. Through Costume NPCs (Dr. Jung, Ara, Suji Jeo, Count D, etc)[/*][/list][/list][list][*]Hair Costume Dyeing is separated into ‘Random Color’ and ‘Selectable Color’.[/*][*]‘Random Color Dyeing’ costs ‘Hair Color Ampoule’, and it chooses a random color under a same rate (Each color has an identical rate) [/*][*]‘Selectable Color Dyeing’ costs ‘Selectable Hair Dyeing Ampoule’, and it chooses a color of your choice.[/*][*]You can bleach an already dyed hair costume through ‘Bleach’ button in Dyeing UI.
[b]   ※ Be careful when dyeing/bleaching hair costume because the process is irreversible.[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Cautions for dyeing/bleaching hair costume:[/b]
[list][*]Packaged hair costumes are unpacked during the process.[/*][*]Successful upgrading/converting a dyed hair costume will remove the color.[/*][*]Repacking, Trading in Black Market, Failing to upgrade/Convert don’t remove the color.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]▶[/b] [b]PNA Mutant EXP Targeting[/b]
[list][*]PNA Mutant EXP Targeting system is added.
[list][*]‘PNA Mutant EXP Targeting’ system enables focusing PNA EXP to a certain Mutant Type.[/*][*]Mutant type that is ‘EXP Targeted’ can earn EXP with priority than other ‘activated’ types.[/*][*]‘PNA Mutant EXP Targeting’ only applies a single Mutant type at a time.[/*][*]It cannot be applied to an already maxed out type, and the setting will automatically be OFF when the selected Mutant type reaches its max level.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]▶[/b] [b]Levia Skill Improvement[/b]
[list][*]Levia’s skills are improved.[/*][/list][table][tr][td][u][b]Skill[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]Change Info[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Flash of Pain[/b][/td][td][b]The attack range is increased.[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Serpent’s Waltz[/b][/td][td][b][Dragon’s Will]’s attack range is increased.[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]EX Dimensional Singularity[/b][/td][td][b]Back Attack / Chase become guaranteed.[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]EX Fang Stab[/b][/td][td][b]The skill continues to be casted even without clicking the button.[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Empowered State[/b][/td][td][b][Dragon’s Will] isn’t casted from time to time – Fixed[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Hell’s Trap – Sphere of Terror[/b][/td][td][b]The casting time is slightly improved.[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
[b]▶[/b] [b]Investigation Group Voting to Expel[/b]
[list][*][b]A system to vote for expelling a member is added to Investigation Group.[/b]
[list][*]Investigation Group Expelling Vote system is designed to maintain a stable dungeon run by expelling unwanted members.[/*][*]There are Voting Host and a target member to expel and the rest will be voters.[/*][*]The vote runs except the target member for 3 minutes and the expelling requires unanimity.[/*][*] There is a cooldown of 10 minutes for the expelling vote in Investigation Group.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]▶[/b] [b]Mock Battle Improvement[/b]
[list][*][b]Mock Battle system is improved.[/b]
[list][*]Mock Battle Bosses can be defeated. (doable for those of 15 million TCP)[/*][*]Mock Battle score is calculated based on a time that it takes to defeat a boss. (The time limits are same as before)[/*][*]Mock Battle now runs ‘Weekly’ not by season, and the highest score will determine the weekly rank and agent rank.[/*][*] Mock Battle Rank is reset at 04:00 on Saturdays UTC.[/*][*] Mock Battle Entrance per character changes : 1 -> 3 times.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Mock Battle reward is changed.[/b]
[list][*]The reward for both Mock Battle Rank and Clear are obtainable only for the character that defeated a boss, and if it fails to defeat a boss, there will be no rank or rewards.[/*][/list][list]· Rank Reward : varies depending a weekly rank(%) before every reset at 04:00 on Saturdays UTC[/list][list]· Clear Reward : can be earned once a week by defeating a boss(1 time per week and per account)[/list][list][*] ‘Training Token’ is added to Mock Battle rewards, which can be used in Crafting Machine to craft various items.[/*][*]‘Training Wolf [D Type]’ is added to UMP Shop.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Other changes on the list along with the overall rate adjustments[/*][/list]
[h3][b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20220511-renewal-gomory-pet/]► Changes on Washing Machine Accumulative Purchase Reward[/url][/b][/h3]
[list][*]New Reward Thresholds are added: ‘250’, ‘500’, ‘700’[/*][*]‘SS Guaranteed D Component: Gear’ is earned as pouch (Tradable)[/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Convenience Improvement – Crew[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/619f91125836f6160a7cf66746181419019ccd3d.png[/img]

[list][*][b]Crew UI is changed.[/b][/*][/list][list][*]Disband/Leave Crew button is moved to the right side of Your Rank.[/*][*]Go to Crew Hangout button is moved to where Disband/Leave Crew button was.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Crew Veteran has an authority to approve a member joining.[/b][/*][/list][list][*]Crew Veteran can approve a member to join.[/*][*]Crew Veteran can see Join Crew Request tab in Crew info window.[/*][/list][list][*][b]A notice is added for Join Crew Request.[/b][/*][/list][list][*]When there is a request to join a crew, a crew icon appears on the lower right corner.[/*][*]Crew Veteran or higher can see the icon.[/*][*]When clicking the icon, Join Crew Request tab opens.[/*][*]When there is a request to join a crew, ‘NEW’ icon appears on the left in Join Crew Request tab.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Search Crew function is improved.[/b][/*][/list][list][*]‘Crew Rank Point’ is added to the conditions of Crew search.[/*][*]‘Crew Rank Point info displayed in Crew search UI takes time to get updated.[/*][/list][list][*][b]The way to save Crew News is improved.[/b][/*][/list][list][*]Max 100 News can be saved.[/*][*]Info displayed in Crew News is fixed.[/*][/list]
[h3][b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20220511-renewal-gomory-pet/]► Random Character Image System[/url][/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]A new system is added: Character images acquired show randomly.[/b]
[list][*]Selecting multiple character images in Character Image tab will show a random image out of them.[/*][*]Once character images are selected in Town Tab, a random image out of them will show when entering Waiting Room, a town, a different channel, and closing a dungeon.[/*][*]Once character images are selected in Sector Tab, a random image out of them will show in case of dungeon loading, squad, UI AND HUD.[/*][*]Click Mouse Right Button to select a character image while Mouse Left Button is for preview.[/*][*]Clicking ‘Reset Selection’ under Image/Pack UI, your pack of selected images is reset and the default image will show.[/*][*]When being on a queue of UNION Arena(PVP), 1 random image will show, and a same image appears on the loading for PVP entering.[/*][*]When applying an image package, all emotes, sound, etc included in the pack will be applied together.[/*][*]Deselecting a selected package doesn’t deselect its character image.[/*][*]When entering a sector or UNION Arena, the order of images is randomly decided, and using Special Move in that sector will show images in that decided order.[/*][*]Character Images for Town/Dungeon that were equipped before May 11 are reset.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Legion Program Improvement[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Legion Program’s dungeon difficulty is adjusted.[/b][list][*]Legion Program’s overall dungeon difficulty is lowered.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]The difficulty of mechanics from Legion Program dungeons is lowered.[/b][list][*] Legion Program – Black Hole Bomb in MACHINARY dungeon now appears in higher waves.[/*][*]Legion Program – Sniper in MACHINARY dungeon is now located near to the middle.[/*][*]Legion Program – Water Drop in DEEPSEA dungeon now has a slower speed.[/*][*]Legion Program – The screen range in DEEPSEA dungeon is changed.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Convenience Improvement[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]How to show Skill Level is changed.[/b][list][*]The way to show + Skill Level from gear, costume, tunning, etc is changed.[/*][*]For + Skill Level from any options, a parentheses will appear next to the level to display its additional skill level. 
ex) Lv.14 (10+4) EX Exceed Pulse[/*][*]Skill Level-Up from general Level-Up shows as it is now.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]‘Skip’ function is added for an item that opens.[/b][list][*]Clicking ‘Enter’ when opening an item, it opens right away while ESC cancel the opening.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Several Mission Objectives are improved for Black Lamb/Wolfdog/Wildhüter.[/b][list][*]As the missions are changed, much faster mission clear is possible than before.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Selfie Mode Improvement[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]The screenshot quality of Selfie Mode is improved.[/b] Lamb/Wolfdog/Wildhüter.[list][*]Checking off HDR in Screen Setting will be applied to Selfi Mode, too.[/*][*]Checking off Anti-aliasing in Screen Setting will be applied to Selfie Mode, too.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]A function to spin a specific emote is added to Selfi Mode. Lamb/Wolfdog/Wildhüter.[/b][list][*]Mouse Left Click during Selfi Mode can spin a specific emote.[/*][*]You can use Spin for ‘Figurine Standing : Cosplay Café emote in Selfi Mode, and it will be applied to the other emotes later.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Gear Farming Improvement[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Farming for some gears is improved.[/b][list][*]Crafting Machine in Busan – Nampodong can craft ‘Transcendent Locust Hell’ gears directly.[/*][*]The number of Scorpion Core Chip that drops from ‘Battle Program: Misook Jang <Original>’ is reduced(16 -> 8) due to the above change.[/*][*]Required amount of Credit is lowered when crafting Speedster Module, Blue Inferno Trinket.[/*][*]The number of ‘Symbol of Affection’ in Box with Memory of Flood that can be earned from Audience with Legion Commander : Ocean King Asmodeus is changed to 5.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Last Minute Notice System[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]A notice system for durational items is added.[/b]
[list][*]When there are items that are about to be expired soon in Inventory or Storage, the system lets you know through Pop up or item UI.[/*][*]The notice appears in case of Login/Logout a character, and moving to Waiting Room.[/*][*]When you have durational items that have less than 1 Day or 7 Day in Inventory or Storage, a pop up will let you know.[/*][*]Checking off ‘Don’t want to see it again today’ in Last minute notice pop up will cease the notice for that day, and this applies per character.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Direct Shop[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Direct Shop system is added.[/b][list][*]When clicking a material item that is required in NPC ‘Vending Machine’, a list of items that can be bought with the material directly opens.[/*][*]When Ctrl + Alt + Mouse Right Button on an item for Direct Shop in Inventory, it directly goes to the shop.[list][*]The list of item for Direct Shop can be checked by the following way.[/*][*]Direct Shop Items : The Direct Shop hot key appears in the item tooltip.[/*][/list][/*][*]Other Items : No Direct Shop hot key info in the tooltip.[/*][*]Direct Shop can be used in hub only and is not available in Your Room/Garden/Crew Hangout/Dungeon.[/*][*]Direct Shop doesn’t support opening inventory, selling items or re-purchase items.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

[h1][b]Private Black Market Conditions Update[/b][/h1]
[i]The conditions for the the Private Black Market has been changed and details has been added![/i]

Hello Agents,

We would like to clarify about what we have mentioned in our previous post ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/215830/announcements/detail/3222895988523264052][b]Pre-Notice: Private Black Market Update[/b][/url]). Individual characters in the account must fulfill the conditions in order to try the Black Market Private trade, instead of only having one character fulfill it.

We hope for your understanding and we apologize for the confusion that this has caused. Below is the specific condition that was changed.

[table][tr][td][table][tr][td]

[b]If there is at least one character that meets the said conditions, the rest of the characters in the same account can get access to Private Black Market.[/b]

[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Previous Condition[/b][/td][/tr][/table][/td][td]
➔
[/td][td][table][tr][td]

[b]Before you will be able to use the Private Black Market feature on a character, the character must achieve the conditions.[/b]

 
[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Updated Condition[/b][/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]

Therefore, you should have [b]at least one level 90 character in the account[/b].

Also, an individual character in the same account must be [b]over [strike]168[/strike] 360 hours from the time it was created[/b] (Please refer to this link for this change: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/215830/view/3228526756479766865][b]Private Black Market – Creation Duration Updated[/b][/url]) and have [b]cleared dungeons for 300 times[/b].

If you wish your other characters to have access to the Black Market Private trade, you must achieve the individual conditions.


[h2][b]Updated Private Black Market Conditions[/b][/h2]

[table][tr][td][u][b]Conditions[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]Details[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]Limit[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td]

[b]Character Level[/b]

[/td][td][b]The character must be level 90[/b][/td][td][b]At least one character in the account[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]

[b]Creation Duration[/b]

[/td][td]
[b]The character must be over [strike]7[/strike] 15 Days old[/b]
[b]([strike]168[/strike] 360 hours or longer)[/b]
[/td][td]
[b]Any characters in the account is eligible, but, the individual conditions should be met.[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]

[b]Dungeon Clears[/b]

[/td][td][b]The character must have cleared dungeons 300 times[/b][/td][td]
[b]Any characters in the account is eligible, but, the individual conditions should be met.[/b]
[/td][/tr][/table]
A Free Private Sale Ticket will still be provided to your account once per day.

Don’t forget to mark your calendar on [b]May 11, 2022[/b] for this exciting update!

notes.title: Pre-Notice: Private Black Market Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

[h1][b]April 6th Private Black Market Update[/b][/h1]
[i]One of the most requested updates is finally here! One-on-one trades will be at ease once the Private Black Market will be available in Closers World.[/i]

Mark your calendar, as the release for this update will be on May 11, 2022.

Here are some early sneak peeks about this update.

[h2][b]Private Black Market Conditions[/b][/h2]

We know everyone is looking forward to this update and wanted everyone to try this opportunity. Therefore, a Free Private Sale Ticket will be provided to your account once per day.

[strike]However, there will be limitations applied to prevent abuse of this new feature. But, if there is at least one character that meets the said conditions, the rest of the characters in the same account can get access to Private Black Market.[/strike]
Please refer to the latest change to this link: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/215830/announcements/detail/3228526127323653983][b]Private Black Market Conditions Update[/b][/url]

[list][*]Required Character Level: 90[/*][*]The character must be over 7 Days old (168 hours or longer)[/*][*]The number of dungeons cleared: 300 times[/*][/list]
[h1][b]Long Awaited Projects![/b][/h1]

[i]Anticipate another roadmap release and a new season for Dev Q&A! We are happy to share our plans for Closers World with you all soon![/i]

[h2][b]Roadmap Release[/b][/h2]

There will be an upcoming announcement of a new Closers World roadmap which is scheduled in the mid of April 2022!

[h2][b]Naddic Dev Q&A[/b][/h2]

Feedbacks and suggestions are truly important to us, and we love to see more of your ideas. Therefore, another Dev Q&A session will now start!

If you have questions, constructive feedback, or suggestions that you wanted to ask and say to the Closers World Developers, post it on the  [b]Official Closers Discord Server[/b] in the [b]#dev-q-and-a[/b] channel.

You may join to the Closers World Discord server by clicking on this image:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/w7hShma][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/a1af9ace8f6b39ecfb67e01066ed7550c3a91950.png[/img][/url]

The development team will answer the frequently asked questions and concerns from the Closers World community! Please remember to be specific in order to make it easier to determine what you truly want to share with us.

The Q&A list will be announced in the Closers Official Website soon by the end of April.

Please note that the #dev-q-and-a will be closed on this schedule by time zone:
[list][*]April 6 at 5:00 PM PDT[/*][*]April 7 at 12:00 AM UTC[/*][*]April 7 at 7:00 AM GMT+7[/*][/list]
However, if you miss the chance to share it in Discord, you may still send it via Support inquiry to [b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/url][/b] or send us an email to [b][url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url][/b].

Thank you and we look forward to your messages!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3f0d8d6f8c523489f6f9b15fc14167af35584f3c.png[/img]

[h1][b]February 16th Update Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h1][b][u]Contents & System[/u][/b][/h1]

[h3][b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20220216-marvelous-updates-renewals/]► Improvements On Game Level Design[/url][/b][/h3]
[list][*]You can now level up your characters of Black Lamb, Wolfdog and Wildhüter more conveniently.[/*][/list][list][b]Black Lambs/Wolfdog Team[/b]
[list][*]EXP from the main mission stream before Busan Nampo-dong area has greatly increased.[/list][/list][list][b]Wildhüter Team[/b][list][*]­Mission flow of the main stream missions of Season 1 and Season 2 has been improved.[/list][/list][list][*]Difficulties of some dungeons are lowered.
[list][*]­In Yod’s Sea, the amount of monster HP to be boosted by the number of squad member is decreased.[/*][*]The amount of monster HP in UNION Division HQ Ch. 2 and UNION Tower is decreased.[/*][*]For some monsters, ‘Damage proportional to HP’ is replaced with Direct Damage.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[table][tr][td][u][b]Affected Dungeon[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td][table][tr][td]
[list]
[*] [b]Subjugation Program: Irina[/b]
[*] [b]Battle Program: Hoffman[/b]
[*] [b]Subjugation Program: David[/b]
[*] [b][Subjugation] Abyssal Throne[/b]
[*] [b]Battle Program: Wolfgang[/b][/list][/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]
[list][*]­For some dungeons, recommended Total Combat Power and recommended item levels are lowered along with the monsters’ stats.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a353cc8f191bd088ea33e90c46c7e029bc9f4854.png[/img]
[list][*]Specifications are changed for some dungeons.
[list][*]Daily Entry Limits are integrated throughout IF dungeons in ‘Dream Theater [Reverse] area.[/*][*]Resurrection Limits of dungeons in ‘Planar Gate – Deep Layer’ area is removed.[/*][*]The prerequisite mission for Battle Program: Misook <<Original>> Dungeon is removed, and the entrance condition is changed as follows:[list][*]Character Level 86 or higher[/*][*]‘Scarlet Scorpion team – Data utilization’ mission cleared[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Player number limit is set to ‘Single only’ for Ancient Dragon’s Nightmare: Heart, Ancient Dragon’s Prison Castle Dungeon.[/*][*]The prerequisite to enter Ancient Dragon Historic Site [Nightmare] is changed.
[/list][list][*]When clearing the mission, ‘Another Nightmare – Proof of Theory’, you can access to [Nightmare] dungeon.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Mission rewards are changed for some dungeons.
[list][*]When opening The SSS reward, ‘Fly King’s Treasure Box (He)’, you can now select 1 trigger out of the box.[/*][*]Gears that you select from early mission rewards were changed for Black Lamb/Wolf dog/ Wildhüter.[/*][*]Some mission rewards now give you full set gears:
[list][*]Target gear: Verita Brigadier/Innocent, Hunter’s Night Epic gear, Demons’ Night Cosmic Trinket, Elite Trigger, Contamination Hell Trinket Set[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Craft list in Crafting Machine is changed/added/removed. [list][*]‘Hunter’s Night’ area’s crafting machine now requires more materials to craft ‘Scavenger’s Gold Treasure Chest’. [/*][*]When crafting ‘Pet Food’ through ‘Hunter’s Night’ area’s crafting machine, the available # to craft is now 3 -> 2.[/*][*]‘Traitor’s Yoke’ is added to ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’s crafting machine. [/*][*]Crafting machine in Divine Battle will no longer craft costume box. [/*][*]Seabreeze Tree Seed is added to Housing’s crafting list. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]The requirement of accepting the entering mission to go to Dream Theater – Reverse area is lowered.[list][*]The prerequisite mission for ‘Over the Curtains’ where you can enter Dream Theater <<Reverse>> is removed. [/*][*]At level 85, all characters can accept ‘Over the Curtains’ mission. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]The Dungeon for [Nightmare] Tiamat mission is changed to mission only dungeon.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]►[b]Changes on Missions[/b][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Ordinary Missions of Black Lamb/Wolf dog that are removed due to the questline improvement are now recovered as ‘Sub Mission’. [list][*]Agents who already cleared those missions before they are deleted cannot clear them again. But you can access to the story in the operational journal. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Summarized story page is added to Operational Journal. [list][*]Whenever each main story is cleared for each area, it appears in the summary page. [/*][*]For Supplementary area story, it appears in the summary page when entering the area. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]►[b][b]New Costume Slot – Footprint[/b][/b][/b][/h3]
[list][*]New Costume slot, ‘Footprint’ is added. [list][*]When equipping Footprint effect, the character’s walk, run, and jump leave its effect on feet. [/*][*]Footprint effect vanishes after some time, and disappears when the character is not moving. [/*][*]Footprint effect has no tuning option and it is obtained as 3-star only. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► [b][b]PNA Mutant – 3 Types Unlocked[/b][/b][/b][/h3]
[list][*]HUMAN / MACHINERY / ANGELIC[/*][/list]
[h3][b]► [b][b]Improvements on Loading Interface[/b][/b][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Loading screen when entering a dungeon is changed. [list][*]The loading tooltip info remain the same. But the space and size of Character Portrait Image is changed. [/*][*]As character Image size is changed, designs of all visual frames are changed. [/*][*][Character Customization]-[Frame] UI is changed. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► [b][b]Black Market Improvements[/b][/b][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Black Market has some improvements in its functions.
[list][*]When closing Black Market UI, the search history is reset.[/*][*]The searching cool down for Black Market is now 5 -> 1 second.[/*][*]When registering items on Black Market, items under evaluation shows ‘Evaluating’ in remaining time.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Favorites function is included in Black Market.
[list][*]If you click a star on the upper right side in Black Market UI, Favorites pop up window opens. [/*][*]You can search items by [SEARCH] tab to add to Favorites, and the search shows every result that include the search word. [/*][*]When you click items searched by [SEARCH] tab, it shows all registered items for sale, and you can add them to Favorites by using Star icon. [/*][*]In (List) tab, you can check all added items in Favorites, and up to 10 can be registered. [/*][*]When clicking an item in (LIST) tab, it shows all registered items on sale currently[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Black Market Guide is added.[list][*]Tips for Favorites is added to the existing Black Market guide.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]►[b]Selfie Mode[/b][/b][/h3]
[list][*]You can now take a picture of your character ingame through Selfie Mode. [list][*]Click ‘Selfie’ button on the right side in character UI. [/*][*]While using ‘Look at the camera’ function in Selfie Mode, character motions are restricted and it switches to default waiting motion. [/*][*]There another function in Selfie Mode UI that helps you take the shot without being bothered by other characters or NPCs. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Functions in Selfie Mode are as follows. [/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6a36c34f1927edc45264cb1045ec24da4f342d90.png[/img]
[h3][b]► Seha/Sylvi character face model improvement[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Seha/Sylvi character face model is improved. [list][*]Seha/Sylvi character face [/*][*]Locations of accessories that are equipped on face are changed. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Convenience Improvement[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Game Play of some dungeons is improved. [list][*]The pop up that appears when clicking ‘Retry dungeon’(F2) in Yod’s Headwaters/Yod’s Sea dungeons asking if you want to go to hub is removed. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Convenience Improvement on Direct Tuning [list][*]When doing Direct Tuning and getting SS Tuning option, the re-try button is deactivated. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Convenience Improvement on consecutive box item opening [list][*]You can now input the number of box items for consecutive opening. [/*][*]‘Skip (Enter)’ is removed from consecutive box opening. [/*][*]The consecutive box opening is faster now. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Personal/Account bank now have more default slots: 25 -> 35 [/*][/list][list][*]All dungeon entries have their button to end conversation not applied, and an extra button to close is added. [/*][*]A function is added to turn ON/OFF the warning message when your Contribution point is max. ‘You cannot earn any more Contribution Bonus’ in the settings. [/*][*]In case you cannot earn Contribution Bonus anymore, Contribution Bonus mark in Dungeon UI will be changed. [/*][/list]

notes.title: Sigsegvhandler Error Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We appreciate all the reports regarding the [b]Sigsegvhandler Error[/b]. Players are receiving this error with several cases and reasons. The main cause of the issue is due to multiple movements or clicks across the Game’s UI.

We deployed a client patch which will take effect after you relaunch the game.
 
Thank you for understanding.

If you encountered this issue, we highly suggest contacting us via Support inquiry to [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url] or send us an email to, [url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url] with your [b]Client log file[/b] that could help us with solving the issue.
