notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a3fd256d9ee082238d5880404fe59fe41c8a81ec.png[/img]
  
[h1][b]SEPTEMBER 8th Update Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h1][b][u][b]Contents & System[/b][/u][/b][/h1]

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210908-gremory-science-facility-update-event--packages/]▶ [b][b]PNA System Renewal & Gremory’s Science Facility[/b][/b][/url]
[list][*]New Dungeon [b]Gremory’s Science Facility[/b] has been updated.

[table][tr][td][b]Dungeon Name [/b][/td][td]
[b]Level[/b]

[b]Requirement [/b]
[/td][td][b]Recommended TCP [/b][/td][td][b]Gear Lv. [/b][/td][td][b]Entrance Restriction [/b][/td][td][b]Entrance Day [/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Gremory’s Science Facility [/td][td]88 [/td][td]15M [/td][td]160 [/td][td]Once per character per day [/td][td]WED/THU/SAT[/td][/tr][tr][td]Gremory’s Science Facility: Mild [/td][td]88[/td][td]6M [/td][td]150 [/td][td]Once per character per day[/td][td]WED/THU/SAT[/td][/tr][/table]
[list][*][b]Gremory Science Facility[/b] can be entered through Gremory’s Dimensional Gate at Planar Gate.[/*][*][b]Gremory Science Facility[/b] opens on every WED/THU/SAT.[/*][*][b]Gremory Science Facility[/b] requires ‘Doctor’s Crisis’ quest clear.[/*][*][b]Gremory Science Facility[/b] related achievements and titles have been added.[/*][*]New dungeons will be included to crew reputation.[/*][*]New dungeons will be included to EX channel bonus.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Quest dungeon [b]Gremory’s Class: Degree Course[/b] has been added.[/*][*]Operation/conquest Progress reward has been added to Gremory dungeons.[/*][*]Some dungeons will not provide PNA EXP anymore.[list][*]Crew dungeon, Commercial/ Guro/ New Seoul/ Gangnam Circuit, Legion Commander dungeons.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Some dungeons will newly provide PNA EXP.[list][*]Ancient Dragon Historic Sites, Subjugation/Battle Program dungeons.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Amount of PNA EXP from some dungeons have adjusted.[list][*]Planar Gate, Planar Gate: Deep Layer, Dream Theater, Dream Theater (Reverse).[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Methods to obtain PNA genes have been changed.[list][*]PNA Random Boxes are not obtainable from quest reward, NPC shop and dungeon clear reward (excluding first clear drop) anymore.[/*][*]New PNA Box has been added to Vending Machine [b]General Support Shop[/b] tab.[/*][*]Components of some PNA Random Boxes have been changed.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Evolution success rate of all PNA genes has been increased by 10%.[/*][*]Name of some PNA genes have been changed.[/*][*]Stats of some PNA genes has been improved.[/*][*]PNA EXP increase has been added to Lore Talisman and Extreme Fighter buff.[/*][/list]

▶ [b]Monster Armor Type Reorganization[/b]
[list][*]Monster armor type has been reorganized into 9 types.[list][*]Armor type options for some gears/set options/titles have been removed or modified.[*]Armor type options for chips/PNA amplifiers have been modified.[*]Armor type options for some buffs have been modified.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]New armor types have been applied to existing dungeons. Dungeon UI will show according to armor type of the dungeon.[/*][/list]
▶ [b][b]PNA Mutant System[/b][/b]
[list][*]PNA Mutant System has been updated.[list][*]Click ‘MUTANT’ tab on the top of the PNA UI to use Mutant system.[*]Each Mutant provide specialized stats for each armor types. Only one Mutant can be activated at a time.[*]When [b]Auto Apply[/b] of Mutant system is ON, the Mutant will be automatically activated according to the dungeon you enter.[*]Level of Each Mutant will be increased according to PNA EXP gained by characters with PNA level 80 or higher while active and can be grown up to level 20.[*]Mutant system can be used after completing the ‘[b]Mutation Gene[/b]’ quest.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Each mutation carries a ‘[b]variant[/b]‘.[list][*]Each mutation has a ‘[b]variant[/b]‘, and with achieving certain level, the ‘variant slot’ will be opened, and you can equip the variants.[*]There are several variants in the specified mutation level, and you can select and equip one of the variants in the same row.[*]Each variant has a grade, and the higher the grade, the higher the variant’s stats.[*]When a variant achieves a certain level, an additional ‘mutation optimization bonus’ will be applied.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Restructure Mutation system that changes the grade of a variant has been added.[list][*]You can increase the grade of a variant through the ‘[b]Restructure Mutation[/b]’ button in the Mutant UI.[*]A certain amount of ‘[b]mutation material[/b]’ will be consumed when the variant level is raised, and the required amount varies for each variant type and grade.[*]‘[b]Mutation materials[/b]’ can be obtained by synthesizing PNA enhancement materials and evolution materials and can be obtained with a certain probability when clearing the Gremory Science Facility dungeon.[*]The more you repeat the synthesis of PNA enhancement materials and evolution materials, the more the required number of materials increases, and it resets at 4:00 AM UTC every day.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210908-babel-40th-expansion]▶ [b][b][b]Babel Program 40th Floor Expansion[/b][/b][/b][/url]
[list][*]Max Floor of Babel Program has been expanded from 30th to 40th.[/*][*]Entrance time per character has been changed from 6 times per a week to 7 times per a month.[/*][*]Reset schedule of Babel Program has been changed from weekly to monthly.[/*][*]Monthly reset will happen on 1st of every month at 4:00 AM UTC.[/*][/list]
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210908-character-skill-balance/]▶ [b][b]Character Skill Balance Update[/b][/b][/url]
[list][*]Some character’s skills have been adjusted. Please check the details in the provided link.[/*][*]Common Passive Skill[/*][/list][table][tr][td][u][b]Transcendental Power (Passive Skill)[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td]1) All armor type damage increase option will be removed.
2) Physical/Psi Power will increase by +10 per skill level. (Skill Lv.10 – Physical/Psi Power +100)
3) Physical/Psi Crit Damage Bonus will increase by +2% per skill level (Skill Lv.10 – Physical/Psi Crit Damage Bonus +20%)
4)Attack Speed will increase by +0.5% per skill level. (Skill Lv.10 – Attack Speed +5%)[/td][/tr][/table]
▶ [b][b][b]UNION Watch Renewal[/b][/b][/b]
[list][*]UNION Watch became account content.[list][*][u][u]If the [/u][u]highest-level[/u][u] character in the account is level 20 or higher, the [/u][u]UNION[/u][u] Watch UI is displayed at the top of the character status window.[/u][/u][*]UNION Watch missions are determined according to the level of the highest-level character in the account.[*]UNION Watch and Contribution system have been integrated so that the Contribution UI is no longer displayed.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]UNION Watch Missions has been categorized.[list][*]You can select the mission category in the upper left corner of the UNION Watch UI, and missions and rewards are shared by all characters in the account.[*][b]Daily Mission:[/b] This is a mission that can be progressed daily, and the mission and rewards are reset at 4:00 AM UTC every day.[*][b]Weekly Mission:[/b] This is a mission that can be progressed on a weekly basis, and the mission and rewards are reset every Saturday at 4:00 AM UTC.[*][b]Dungeon Mission:[/b] This is the same mission as the mission provided in Contribution system, and the mission and rewards are reset every day at 4:00 AM UTC.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]UNION Watch Reward has been renewed.[/*][*][u][u]UNION Watch clear achievement has been changed.[/u][/u][list][*][b]Previously:[/b] Achievements can be progressed when all UNION Watch missions cleared.[*][b]Changed:[/b] You can proceed with the achievements when you acquire UNION Watch bonus rewards from daily/weekly[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Exchange items have been updated to UNION Watch tab in Vending Machine.[/*][*][u][u]Lucky Phase Token is now movable to account storage.[/u][/u][/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]Teamwork Buff Renewal[/b][/b][/b]
[list][*][u][u]Teamwork [/u][u]Buff [/u][u]System has been renewed.[/u][/u][list][*][u][u]Click the [/u][u][b]Teamwork Buff[/b] [/u][u]button in the character information list at the bottom to display the UI.[/u][/u][*]You can place the character created in your account in the team buff slot.[*]Your team’s points increase as much as the level of the placed character.[*]If team of the slot and the placed character matches, additional points will be obtained.[*]Only characters with higher promotion than regular agent/crew or resolver can be placed in the team buff slot.[*]Stats are determined according to the points acquired from each team, and the currently applied stats can be checked in the [b]Stats[/b] window.[*]After placing the character in the team buff slot, click the ‘Apply’ button to complete the placement, and the added stats will be reflected in the Total Combat Power.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
▶ [b][b]Name Tag System[/b][/b]
[list][*]New decoration – Name tag has been updated.[/*][*]Name tag system is for decorating your character’s name displayed on the top of your character model.[/*][*]Name tag system is applied per character, not per account.[/*][*]Name tag can be set in [b]Skin Pack[/b]–[b]Illust[/b]–[b]Name[/b] [b]Tag[/b] menu.[/*][*]Name tags cannot be individually selected for each category – Hub, Dungeon and UNION Arena. The selected name Tag will be displayed in everywhere.[/*][*]You cannot use the same name tag ticket while holding the permanent name tag.[/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]Enhancement System Changes[/b][/b][/b]
[list][*][b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210824-enhancement-success-rate-increase/]Enhancement Success Rate has been greatly increased.[/url][/b][/*][*]Duration Time of Enhancement Buff Voucher has been extended from 24h to 30days.[/*][*]Enhancement Buff now allows enhancing +13 or above gears only.[/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]Investigation Group Convenience Improvement[/b][/b][/b]
[list][*]Some improvements have been made for the convenience of the investigation group.[list][*][b]Crew Channel[/b] of the created investigation group is displayed on the Find Investigation Group page.[*]If crew channel of the selected investigation group and your character are different, you can jump to the corresponding crew channel[*]Characters in other crew channels now can be invited to the investigation group.[*]The invitee can directly jump to the crew channel of the investigation group.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]If the character invited to the investigation group is not in hub, has joined another squad, or has not cleared the required mission, invitation failure pop-up will be displayed.[/*][*]If the character invited to the investigation group is displaying another UI, the invitation failure message will not be displayed.[/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]Transcendence Stone Convenience Improvement[/b] [/b][/b]
[list][*][u][u]Some transcenden[/u][u]ce [/u][u]stone extract crafting has been added.[/u][/u][u] [/u][list][*]Transcendence Stone Extracts of the Ocean King / Locust Hell/ Old Castle have been added[/*][/list][/list][list][*]The names of transcendence stones/extracts in the Matter Mixer and the order of the crafting list have been changed.[list][*]The names of transcendence stones/extracts have been changed to make it easier to understand the corresponding transcendence level and gear type of the item.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]Chip System UI Improvement[/b] [/b][/b]
[list][*]If there is insufficient credit for chip crafting, the credit will be displayed in red.[/*][*]UI will clearly show how many chips you are crafting and the crafting count.[/*][*]When overclock EXP decreased with the chip transfer, an alert will be displayed.[/*][*]+0 gears cannot be registered to Chip Transfer UI with an alert.[/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]Locust Hell Farming Difficulty Mitigation[/b][/b][/b]
[list][*][u][b]Notice: This will be applied during the Centum City update. We ask for your understanding.[/b][/u][/*][/list]

[list][*][u]You can access the trigger pop-up through the [/u][u]Mission Map for a[/u][u]ll dungeons.[/u][/*][*]You can use Trigger menu without going back to hubs after clearing dungeons.[/*][*]‘[b]Trigger Preset[/b]’ feature has been added.[/*][/list]

[list][*]Defense Penetration options are reflected to the Total Combat Power calculation.[/*][*]Defense Penetration options have been added to some gear set options.[list][*]Fierce Dimensional Beast / Verita Trinket Set / Despair of the Unknown Closer.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h1][b]AUGUST 18th Update Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[u][h1][b]Contents & System[/b][/h1][/u]

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210818-eunha-black-hands/]▶ [b]Eunha Black Hands Promotion[/b][/url]
[list][*]Eunha’s new promotion has been added.[/*][*]Eunha ‘Black Hands’ promotion can be progressed through the ‘Black Hands’ episode in the ‘Fantasy World: Dream Theater’ area.[/*][*]When you clear the Eunha ‘Black Hands’ episode, you will receive a ‘Black Hands Costume Box (3 days)’ item.[/*][*]Eunha Black Hands skills have been added.[/*][/list][table][tr][td][b]Black Hands Advisor: Eunha[/b]
The ultimate state that Eunha has attained in the worst-case future scenario.

Originally, Eunha could have never gained such great power, but she was able to obtain it by undergoing trials in Fantasy World. She can use [Special Move: Meteor Smash] in order not to reach the worst possible future, but to avoid it. Using Messenger Special Move triggers [Advisor’s Disturbance], which is enhanced by the skill level of [Special Move: Meteor Smash].

[Advisor’s Disturbance] triggered by Messenger Special Move
counts as [Air Strike / Back Attack / Chase].
[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Special Move: Meteor Smash[/b]

Meteor Smash is a fatal blow landed on enemies while shouting its skill name after concentrating enormous amount of phase force on one’s fist. Becomes [Invincible] for the skill duration. [Meteor Smash] always counts as [Critical], [Air Strike / Back Attack / Chase].

“I was just a single star, but as for you, I hope you become someone who can embrace countless stars.”

notes.title: Fanart Contest Voting Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

It has come to our attention that there are several accounts joining the Closers Discord server in a short period of time in order to increase votes from entries in the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210721-closers-summer-fan-art-contest/][b]Fanart Contest[/b][/url].

The team has reviewed this and sadly we are limited with options to filter out those accounts that are not authentic or owned specifically by a unique user.

Therefore, we would like to announce that [b]votes from accounts who joined in Closers Discord server before we started the Discord Fanart contest (July 21, 2021 at 2:30 AM UTC) will only count towards the final Fanart voting[/b]. We hope for your understanding.

Be warned that we will closely monitor the voting activities of the entries until the event ends on [b]August 16, 2021 at 12:00 AM UTC[/b]. Any confirmed violators will be disqualified from this event and any community events that we will have in the future.

Thank you and we hope for a fair vote results from the community.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/url][/b]

Or send us an email to:

Also, if you see any suspicious players or find any critical bugs, please report them immediately to our Customer Support and we will investigate them further.

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

notes.title: November 5 Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Game Content[/h1]

[h2]1) New Character[/h2]
[list]
[*] Team Rattus Mirae has been added.
[list]
[*] Mirae starts with Lv.67 when created.
[*] Mirae’s Maximum Level is Lv.83, and it will be expanded through future updates.
[*] Mirae Season 1 scenarios and areas will be opened.
[/list]
[*] Draconian rare costumes can be synthesized with Mirae characters.
[/list]
[h2]2) New Area – Ancient Dragon Historic Site[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new area ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ has been added, and can be entered by characters level 85 or higher.
[*] Existing areas have been deleted due to the reorganization of the Dimensional Ops Center.
[*] New towns, dungeons, bosses, quests, achievements, and items have been added.
[*] The basic difficulty dungeon and the Nightmare difficulty dungeon are opened together.
[list]
[*]In order to enter the Dungeon of Nightmare difficulty by random matching, you must be promoted to Black Lambs, Wolfdogs, Wildhüter Task Force or higher, and Rattus Fixer or higher. (Mirae Fixer will be updated later)
[/list]
[*] Some dungeons can only be entered on certain days of the week.
[list]
[*] Ancient Dragon’s Nightmare: Heart -Mon/Thu/Sat/Sun
[*] Ancient Dragon’s Prison Castle-Tue/Fri/Sat/Sun
[/list][/list]

[h1]System Update[/h1]

[h2]1) Chip Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] The chip system has been completely reorganized.
[list]
[*] Chip has been changed to account sharing.
[*] Gears with chips equipped cannot be traded, and when Equip/Unequip, the basic transaction properties of the gear are followed.
[*] Chip UI has been integrated, and you can proceed with Equip/Unequipped/ Overclock through the chip inventory (shortcut key ‘ ; ’).
[*] The chip protect item is not consumed when removing the chip equipped on the gear.
[*] Chip slots can be created only for gear of level 83 or higher.
[*] You cannot change the slot color or open the slot for gear under level 83 where chip slots were created before reorganization. (Available: Equip/Unequip/Overclock)
[/list]
[*] Chip types and grades have been reorganized.
[list]
[*] The grade of chips has been reorganized by tier. (T1, T2, T3)
[*] Platinum chip is available up to T2 and color chip is available up to T3.
[*] You can collect chips from the lower tier to craft chips from the upper tier.
[*] Dark chip has been changed to white chip.
[*] As the chips were reorganized, the chips and chip boxes held before the update were collectively changed to [Origin Chips]. [[url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/chip-exchange-ratio/]Go to exchange rate[/url]]
[/list]
[*] A chip overclock system has been added.
[list]
[*] An overclocking system has been added that increases the chip’s stats by using material chips to equipped chips.
[*] The maximum value of overclock is the same as the enhancement level of the gear equipped with the chip.
[*] When the overclocked chip is removed from the gear, the overclock level and experience value are reset.
[/list]
[*] Color driver has been integrated.
[*] A new chip slot has been added to the Shield and Amplifier items. (1 shield, 3 amplifiers)
[/list]
[h2]2) Pet Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] The pet system has been completely reorganized.
[list]
[*] Pet system UI has been reorganized.
[*] Pet can be now shared within the account.
[/list]
[*] A pet rarity system has been added.
[list]
[*] Pet rarity is divided into < [b]Normal [/b]> and < [b]Elite [/b]>.
[/list]
[*] A pet enhancement system has been added.
[list]
[*] Pet enhancement can be performed up to 5 stages, and the quantity of materials used for enhancement varies by stage.
[*] When you equip an enhanced pet, some of the character’s stats increase and are reflected in the overall combat power.
[/list]
[*] A pet disassembly system has been added.
[list]
[*] You can obtain the required for pet enhancement by disassembling the pet.
[/list]
[*] A system for automatic use of pet items has been added.
[list]
[*] You can use the automatic item use system if you upgrade your pet to 3 levels.
[/list]
[*] A pet skin system has been added.
[list]
[*] You can set the appearance of your pet with the pet you currently have through the Pet Details tab.
[/list]
[*] Pet Codex system has been added.
[*] New Pet Mini Syrphid ([b]Elite[/b]) and Mini Bai ([b]Normal[/b]) have been added.
[/list]
[h2]3) Black Market Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] The black market transaction maximum has been changed to 2 billion credits.
[*] A function has been added to re-register items that are not sold.
[*] A function has been added that allows you to receive the sold money to another character in your account.
[*] The restrictions on using the black market have been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Level Limit: Lv.35: Deleted
[*] Maintain condition for 72 hours after character creation
[*] After creating a character, clear the dungeon 20 times to use Black Market.[/list][/list]
[h2]4) Reorganization of Growth Path[/h2]
[list]
[*] The growth path of Black Lambs and Wolfdogs team has been greatly improved.
[*] Skill Manual is also added on Black Lambs, Wolfdogs’ contribution shop
[/list]

[h1]Events[/h1]

[h2]1) Transfer Celebration Special Event:[/h2]

[h2]3) Ancient Dragon Historic Site Opening, Chip Update Event[/h2]

notes.title: BUSAN CH.2 AND BRANCH UPDATE
notes.notes:
Busan Chapter 2 is live! Log in to find out what happens next for our Closers. Also check out the improvements we've made to the character selection and creation process. Oh, and guess what... Bai and Seth are ready for PVP!

[url=https://forums.enmasse.com/closers/discussion/10897/may-11-patch-notes-busan-ch-2-branch-update]For all the details on P26 changes, please review our patch notes on our forums. [/url]

And as a special bonus, during the month of May we’re offering a special, “Stay Home, Stay Safe” weekday buff. Enjoy a 20% increase in additional items and experience when clearing sectors weekdays (Monday through Friday) in May. 

[h2]Busan Leveling Event
[/h2]Busan Chapter 2 increases the level cap for all characters to 88, and we’ve got a fresh new leveling event to help you push your Closers to the top.

Log in with any character level 10 or higher and receive an Untouchable Challenge Box (limit 1 per account) containing special +14 gear designed for leveling. You’ll also gain special rewards at levels 70, 85, and 88, including a +13 Gear Booster!

[h2]Ice Dancer Costume Set
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/097a0232d85ee08123120b80e6a5876643033434.png[/img]

It’s the hottest look on ice, and you’ll want to lace up your skates and slide over to the nearest Washing Machines to get it. With three color variants, four character illustrations, and a special headpiece accessory, you won’t want to miss out on this great costume.

[h2]Mission License Season 3
[/h2]Mission License season 3 starts Monday, May 11, and runs through Monday, June 8. Pick up an Event License and License Boosters in the EMP Store to maximize your rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4ef936e1acccea6aa9fb21d44621c503e19ea437.png[/img]

[h2]Cross Material Conversion
[/h2]Enjoy special CMC discounts from Monday, May 11 to Monday, June 22, including great savings on Hot items like the Fallen Night and Dark Command sets, and a chance at the new Ice Dancer [B] costume pieces!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f2c68563eee18b16d70950696a1ce03299e04f39.png[/img]

[h2]Busan Chapter 2 special packages and chain discounts
[/h2]Starting Monday, May 11, and continuing until Monday, June 8, enjoy great chain discounts on Busan Knights packages, full to the rim with fantastic items to tune up your characters’ equipment. The more you buy, the more you save!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ee6880b55568917ebed5e1749179733474c2fc5f.png[/img]

And also in the month of May (Monday, May 11 to Monday May 25), shop the EMP store for Busan Challenger packages full of even more useful items, including CMC tickets and Alpha Equalizers. These great bundles are available in limited quantities for a limited time only, so be sure and pick some up while you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5429fc3a0ec23fb51b97895409bdbb15bcfb3049.png[/img]

[h2]Yuri Birthday Celebration
[/h2]Join us for cake and presents starting Sunday, May 17 at 06:00 UTC (May 16 at 11:00 PM Pacific) as we celebrate Yuri Seo’s birthday! The birthday celebration only runs for 24 hours so log in before all the cake is gone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d4b8fe53e61550e4629d58ee5c610770ae56bd81.jpg[/img]

We can't wait to see you in game!

notes.notes:
The [u]Closers[/u] June update is right around the corner! Right after Seha’s birthday event, and after a couple hours of downtime on Monday, June 4 at 10 p.m. PDT, you can log in and start enjoying all the new features and events, including:

[list]  [*][b][u]Closers[/u] Summer Vacation[/b]—Visit the Gangnam Evac Center for summer vacation festivities! Play the limited-time Event Stage to earn unique rewards and craft items, including summer-themed weapon skins.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/f12108c325568d9a055014bc25c97a762da97552.jpg[/img][/*]  [*][b]3v3 Arena Brawl[/b]—Compete with your Crew in the new 3v3 Arena Brawl mode. Compete during Arena Time for additional rewards!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/4fb97e21bf4abb15b6649a49eea912aa0ca1386f.jpg[/img][/*]  [*][b]Special Agent Seha[/b]—Take the promotion exam with Seha and achieve the rank of Special Agent! We’ve filled the coming weeks with events to help you get there, and we'll be releasing more Special Agent promotions in the future, so stay tuned.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/cf0b7ad6a7a52ba26dfb587f0d908a600650cf09.jpg[/img][/*][*][b]Total Combat Power Ranking[/b]—The Hero Brazier has appeared in Planar Gate! Every day, when you log out, your combat power ranking will be recorded. Statues of top players will be displayed around the Brazier! Team logos will also be featured, depending on which team (Wolf Dogs or Black Lambs) have the most powerful characters overall. [/*][/list][h1]Promotion and Birthday Events[/h1]
Need a little help leveling up your Seha—or maybe just a little more incentive? We've got you covered with special events and rewards:
[list]  [*] [b]Seha Leveling Reward[/b]—Log in with Seha at levels 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, and 75 to get special rewards (upon first login). If you've already leveled Seha, you'll get rewards for all the levels you previously achieved. [/*]  [*] [b]Seha Special Agent Costume[/b]—Collect 72 Demon King's Goblet, 540 Sealed Queen's Eye, 100 Chromatic Phase Essence, and 15 Sticky Residue to craft a 1-Star permanent Special Agent costume for Seha! But hurry—you'll only be able to craft the Special Agent costume until Monday, July 30, at 10 p.m. PDT.[/*]  [*]  [b]Clear and Craft with Seha[/b]— Clearing sectors that cost 10 Fatigue or more (or sectors in the Dimensional Ops Center) with Seha earns you a Special Agent Certificate. Collect Special Agent Certificates to get rewards like Superior Accessory Boxes, Gear Boosters, and more![/*]  [*] [b]Birthday Events[/b]—Seha and Levia have birthdays this month! Log in and play between Sunday, June 3, at 6 a.m. server time, and Monday, June 4, at 5:59 a.m. server time to celebrate Seha's special day! And log in and play between Wednesday, June 6, at 6 a.m., and Thursday, June 7, at 5:59 a.m. server time to celebrate Levia's birthday. Logging in on either day gives you 20 pieces of cake and a small plum soda!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/5d2cae647391762d3bdef74e5c530490fe87a3f7.jpg[/img][/*][/list][h1] EMP SHOP/BITNA [/h1]
 But wait, there’s more! Visit Bitna, or drop by the EMP Shop after the update, for all of your June update sales and bargains:
[list]  [*] [b]Premium Pirate Packs Are Back[/b]—Premium Pirate Packs return to the EMP Shop in June, and this time, with no limitations! These special packs only award costume pieces for your current Closer. In addition, your odds of obtaining a great item are better than with a regular Pirate Washing Machine.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/073c8c2c67c4610dc1860fc648a36aff3264b00b.png[/img][/*]  [*] [b]Ninja Costume Washing Machines[/b]—Strike from the shadows! Ninja costumes are now available in Bitna's shop.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/ce8caaf692c56edd2897a6e1d17676cc026857a7.png[/img][/*]  [*] [b]Harpy Costume Packs[/b]—You’ll find Harpy Business Suit and Academy Costume Packs available at the in-game EMP Shop! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/8c94885aa62881391d6251255d04f84ae81712f4.png[/img][/*]  [*] [b]Seha Special Agent Package (one purchase per character)[/b]—Speed up your progress towards Special Agent with the Seha Special Agent Package, available Tuesday, June 5 after maintenance until Monday, June 18, at 10 p.m. PDT. Each pack contains materials to get you a head start on crafting Seha's Special Agent Costume, a collection of "Starlight" consumables that will boost experience, recover HP, and decrease Fatigue on your Seha character. Not only that, you'll also get a 3-Star Boss random weapon box!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/e496cde879823a5f416be182c7014e78305eb93b.png[/img][/*]  [*] [b]Mini Seha Pet[/b]—Celebrate Seha's promotion with a tiny Seha pet! Seha pet packages are available in Egg and Adult varieties until Monday, July 2, at 10 p.m. PDT.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/d77755cf762ae81ede792c0bd8cecf108261c5c5.png[/img][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Renovation Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/b04ae065ebaec59c04501101bc0176eb54b6076b.jpg[/img]

Our next Closers update introduces numerous improvements to all aspects of the game, including (but not limited to) leveling curve tweaks designed to get you to max level faster, changes to achievement and crafting, shorter load times, and more. The Renovation Update will release early next week (the week of May 7).

[url=https://forums.enmasse.com/closers/discussion/4310/renovation-update-patch-notes]Read our complete patch notes for more details![/url]

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[b]Housing Multi Play[/b]. 

Invite your friends and crew members to visit your room!

[b]Dimensional Gel Conversion.[/b] 

Dimensional Gel Season 1 begins with this update! For each Dimensional Washing Machine you purchase from Bitna, you'll receive one Dimensional Gel (plus a bonus 10 for purchasing 10 machines at once). Each season offers different rare items to craft with this Gel. In the first season, you can craft a new Amethyst Icon costume pieces plus Dark Command Accessories!

[h1]EVENTS[/h1]
[b]Welcome (Back), Closers![/b]

When we return from the Renovation Update maintenance, our Welcome Back event begins to celebrate new and returning Closers with [u]free stuff[/u]! We’ll also be running a crafting event, so be sure to log in every day.

[b]May Attendance Event.[/b]

We also have a special schedule of daily rewards for logging in! You can track your progress and see what's coming in our all new in-game event calendar. 

[h1]EMP SHOP/BITNA[/h1]
[b]Yarg! There Be Pirate Costumes.[/b]

You can now get Pirate costumes in Bitna's Washing Machine shop! When you have the full set equipped, you'll unlock a unique emote.

Right after maintenance, you can purchase 5 Washing Machines for 500 EMP per day per account in the EMP Shop! To increase the speed of collecting the set for your favorite character, you'll only get costume pieces for your current character in this EMP shop pack.

[b]New Tina Costumes.[/b]
 
Tina has a bunch of new costume sets available with this update! She gets all three variants of the Caregiver costume, a Xiao NPC costume, and Domestic costume pieces from Washing Machines.

notes.title: Planar Raid Update
notes.notes:
The April 17 Planar Raid Update introduces new challenges at the Planar Gate and increases Tina's level cap to 75!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/2f71d35a7d78e77f8fcc857871a857afa55093b7.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW FEATURES:[/h1]
We’ve got two major new features in store for you, Closers:
[list][*]We’ve added Planar Gate Raid quests and stages, providing players of level 73 and above with a new challenge! These encounters introduce new gear, accessory items, achievements, and more. Head to Planar Gate to get started (and we recommend playing with a group).[/*][*]We’ve also increased Tina's level cap to 75, giving her access to the Refit Sky Ship hub and quests.[/*][/list][h1]NEW EVENTS[/h1][list][*]Defeat Mephisto and Vitus; Save the World!—Once per account, upon first login after maintenance, you’ll receive a box full of powerful gear to give you a taste of what you can unlock from the Planar Gate raids. This box contains temporary versions of the Phase Wings earned by challenging Vitus and Mephisto, plus a box of +12 Ultimate Gear, which includes an ultimate core, 2 modules, and 3 trinkets.[/*][*]Complete stages that consume 10 Fatigue or more, and you’ll receive tokens you can use to craft special rewards, including accessories and enhancement material boxes![/*][/list][h1]EMP SHOP/BITNA[/h1][list][*]Head out on patrol with Security Guard costumes![/*]

[*]Tina Academy Packages—The Tina Academy costume bundle will be available in three different colors! And until the May 14 maintenance, each bundle comes with a pair of Half-Rimmed Glasses.
[/*][*]Raid Ready Packages—Until the Monday, April 30 downtime, we'll be offering packages of enhancement materials and temporary accessories to get you raid-ready faster![/*][*]Tina Icon Comes to Bitna—Bitna’s Washing Machines may now produce 2- and 3-Star versions of Tina's Onyx, Ruby, and Sapphire Icon costumes.[/*][/list][h1]SEE YOU TUESDAY, APRIL 17[/h1]
On Monday, April 16, at 10 p.m. PDT, we’ll take the servers down for maintenance, and we expect to be back online with the Tina update on Tuesday, April 17. See you then!

notes.title: Changes to the Collector's Edition
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/677fa2484e9505326c3b1b1d744a98cecf663faa.png[/img]

Hello Everyone,

We are making some changes to our Collector’s Edition packs, starting right now! These changes are based on your feedback over the past month. We are now offering two editions.

The current Digital Collector’s Edition has been reduced to $49.99 – this pack can be purchased multiple times.

The all new Deluxe Collector’s Edition will be sold at $69.99 (1 redemption per account) and include the following:

-- Nightmare Costume
-- 30 Day Elite 
-- 30 Day Midnight Wings 
-- 2000 EMP
-- 5 Small Plum Sodas
-- 30 Day Gardening Voucher
-- 30 Day Maid Service Voucher

For the early adopters, who’ve already purchased the Collectors pack - we will be sending you all the new items for each purchase (2K EMP, 5 Stamina Pots, Gardening and Maid Vouchers) automatically. You should receive these within 24 hours of this post. If you do not see them after that, please write in to our Support Team and they will get you hooked up.

Thank you for your continued support and passion – you are the best players in the world.
